Backend는 상시 다중 사용자 중앙 서비스가 아니라 **호스트 세션: The backend is not an always-on, multi-user central service but a **host session coordinator and relay**.
**호스트가 권위다.** 결정론 시뮬레이션은 호스트 클라이언트에서만 굴러: **The host is the authority.** The deterministic simulation runs only on the host client. The backend neither interprets nor executes the meaning of game commands; it reads only the fields needed for routing.
**세션은 휘발성이다.** 호스트가 멀티플레이 옵션을 켜면 세션이 열리고: **Sessions are ephemeral.** A session opens when the host turns on the multiplayer option, and closes when the host turns it off or disconnects. Host migration, session persistence, matchmaking, and a friend system are not provided. The canonical world data is the host's local save (the single-player campaign contract is preserved).
**신원은 기존 Auth를 재사용한다.** 회원가입·로그인이 만드는 Ac: **Identity reuses the existing Auth.** Session participants are verified with the AccountIdx and SessionKey created by sign-up and login. *(Deprecated 2026-09-18, superseded by [ADR-006](ADR-006-backend-aspnet-core-coordinator.md): the existing Auth is deleted, and identity is issued and verified inside the coordinator process.)*
Hero·Lobby·Station·Social 계정 서비스는 삭제하지 않: The Hero, Lobby, Station, and Social account services are preserved rather than deleted, but are set aside as **account meta features unrelated to sessions**. *(Deprecated 2026-09-18, superseded by [ADR-006](ADR-006-backend-aspnet-core-coordinator.md): the account meta services are deleted without being preserved.)*
**전송 분리.** 세션 생성·발견·조회·종료는 기존 CoreWCF HT: **Transport separation.** Session creation, discovery, lookup, and termination follow the existing CoreWCF HTTP (1219) pipeline, while the real-time relay (guest commands→host, host event batches→guests) opens on a separate Kestrel WebSocket port (setting `RealtimePort`, default 1220). Because Y2K `WcfHttpServerCore` owns 1219, the same port is not used. *(Deprecated 2026-09-18, superseded by [ADR-006](ADR-006-backend-aspnet-core-coordinator.md): Y2K and CoreWCF are dropped, and everything is served from a single Kestrel on 1219 using Minimal API + raw WebSocket. The dual-port `RealtimePort` setup goes away.)*

대체 범위: ADR-005 결정 2·3과 ADR-006 결정 7이 제품: Superseded scope: The provisions where ADR-005 Decisions 2 and 3 and ADR-006 Decision 7 act as the product session lifetime, authoritative process, root of participant identity, and world preservation. This document is a product GDD. It is not a record of completed implementation.
ADR-005는 상시 다중 사용자 중앙 서비스가 아니라 호스트가 연 세션: ADR-005 assumed sessions opened by a host rather than an always-on multi-user central service, and ADR-006 carried that assumption in an in-process-memory coordinator. In that model, the deterministic simulation runs on the host client, session credentials disappear together with the session itself, and the canonical world is kept in one place, the host's local storage. Friend lobbies, dedicated servers, Steam authentication, direct LAN connection, and checkpoint fork policy were left unaddressed.
소유자가 2026-09-22 제품 계약을 로컬 우선으로 확정했다. 클라우: On 2026-09-22 the owner confirmed the product contract as local-first. The cloud does not own the canonical world. The authoritative simulation is not the client but a headless server process of the same form. Steam handles only lobbies, transport, authority evidence, and optional server advertisement, and does not own world state. LAN without Steam must work through direct transport.
`Backend/`의 ASP.NET Core 코디네이터는 ADR-006의: The ASP.NET Core coordinator in `Backend/` is the implementation record of ADR-006. Do not regard this record as completed implementation of the product contract.
**제품은 로컬 우선이다.** 클라우드 우선이 아니다. Unity 클라이: **The product is local-first.** It is not cloud-first. The Unity client launches the bundled headless authoritative server as a separate child process, and the local player connects to it over localhost. An optionally installable headless dedicated server uses the same server executable, world, and configuration formats.
**Steam Dedicated Server Tool을 별도 Tool/A: **The Steam Dedicated Server Tool is distributed free as a separate Tool/AppID.** The goal is anonymous SteamCMD installation, with per-OS depots. The actual package and permission settings need confirmation from the Steamworks partner. The dedicated tool can create new worlds and lineages without owning the game. Actual players must have a legitimate signed client and DRM proof.
**Steamworks는 세션 보조만 한다.** 친구·임시 세션은 Ste: **Steamworks provides session support only.** Friend and ad hoc sessions use Steam Lobby and invitations. The default for internet transport is Steam Networking Sockets and Steam Datagram Relay. Steam authentication tickets prove player authority and online identity. Public dedicated servers can be advertised through the Game Server API and the server browser. Steam features do not own authoritative world state.
**Steam 없는 LAN은 직접 LAN 전송·발견으로 동작한다.** 참: **LAN without Steam works through direct LAN transport and discovery.** The canonical root of participant identity is the world-scoped participant public key and recovery secret. The SteamID is optional evidence tied to a Steam session. Clients whose signed client and local DRM proof are unverified can read local saves and play singleplayer, but cannot host or join multiplayer or sign checkpoints.
**검증된 체크포인트만 호스트 씨앗이 된다.** 모든 검증 체크포인트는: **Only verified checkpoints become host seeds.** Every verified checkpoint contains the world state, the event ledger position, the in-progress battle checkpoint (if any), the build, schema, content, and protocol versions, the lineage ID, the parent checkpoint hash, participant bindings, the fork policy, and the signature and hash. Every participant receives a signed checkpoint receipt and projection metadata so that they can verify the current world and ledger position and preserve their own archive and bindings. A complete, hostable world snapshot is distributed or exported only when that checkpoint's immutable fork policy is **Allow**. Participants who are forbidden to fork are not given state complete enough to seed a server, but they continue to receive their own archive and character records. Only a fully verified atomic checkpoint can be used to start hosting on an authoritative server.
**받은 체크포인트를 호스트하면 항상 영구 독립 분기다.** 새 계보 I: **Hosting a received checkpoint always creates a permanent independent fork.** A new lineage ID and key are generated. Forks are not merged automatically. Participants receive a public key for verification and do not receive the parent lineage's signing secret. Only the holder of the original lineage key can continue the same lineage. A lost lineage secret can be restored only from an encrypted recovery backup. Without a backup, the parent lineage is read-only and progress is possible only by forking.
**공개 전용 서버 운영자가 분기 허용·금지를 고른다.** 그 정책은 각: **The public dedicated server operator chooses whether forking is allowed or forbidden.** That policy is signed into each checkpoint and does not change for that checkpoint. A policy change applies only to subsequent checkpoints. Only checkpoints that allow forking include and export a complete, hostable world snapshot.
**세션 자격은 휘발성이다. 월드·인물 바인딩은 체크포인트에 남는다.**: **Session credentials are volatile. World and character bindings remain in checkpoints.** `personId` occupancy does not expire when a session ends or goes idle. It is released only when the participant explicitly gives it up. A host kick blocks rejoining but does not release occupancy or erase character records.
**재참가 신원은 월드 참가자 복구 비밀이다.** 비밀을 잃으면 호스트가: **Rejoin identity is the world participant recovery secret.** If the secret is lost, the host can reissue it after confirming the person's identity outside the game, and the old secret is revoked. There is no automatic in-game identity proof.
**오프라인 점유 인물은 세계 안의 일상·정치 NPC로 남는다.** 원정: **An offline occupied character remains a daily-life and political NPC in the world.** They cannot start an expedition or make player-only decisions. They can be injured or die. At the moment of death, the succession rule already set is evaluated immediately, and the binding is transferred or a game over is recorded. An offline successor is a daily-life and political NPC until they reconnect.
**각 참가자는 자신이 플레이했거나 죽은 인물 기록의 로컬 아카이브를 둔: **Each participant keeps a local archive of the character records they played or who died.** The host world holds the original records. If a local archive is lost, it can be reconstructed from records signed by the host after the recovery secret and a human check.
**세계 시간은 플레이어가 한 명 이상 연결되어 있을 때만 흐른다.**: **World time flows only while at least one player is connected.** When the count reaches zero, the server writes and distributes a verified checkpoint and then halts world and NPC simulation. If the last player leaves during battle, the immutable battle context, accepted commands, and current battle state are immediately captured in a checkpoint and the server halts. It does not auto-resolve or roll back.
**비정상 종료 다음 시작은 서명·해시가 통과한 가장 최신 완전 체크포인: **After an abnormal shutdown, the next start automatically reads the most recent complete checkpoint that passes signature and hash checks, and clearly reports conflicts and the lost interval.** A normal shutdown blocks new joins, saves and checkpoints, finishes distribution and confirmation, and then exits.
**불변 실행 파일·런타임과 영속 월드·설정·체크포인트·백업 데이터를 분: **Immutable executables and runtime are separated from persistent world, configuration, checkpoint, and backup data.** Each active lineage has exactly one writer. The default end-user path is a native child process. Docker and systemd packaging is an optional path for dedicated operators and is not required of players.
Steam 로비·소켓·인증 티켓·서버 브라우저가 월드 상태·원장·체크포인: It is a violation of this ADR if Steam lobbies, sockets, authentication tickets, or the server browser become the canonical source of world state, the ledger, or checkpoint signatures.
부분 검증·손상·서명 실패 체크포인트로 호스팅을 시작하지 않는다. 거절은: Hosting is not started from a partially verified, corrupted, or signature-failed checkpoint. Rejection is a clear error, and the previous backup is preserved.

Route adjacency, layer, access rights, and blockades are checked, and a command that is illegal from the start is not partially executed. After a valid command is accepted, dynamic blockades/encounters are re-evaluated as time events, and no policy that rewinds distance validly moved in the past is arbitrarily created. Stopping at ZOC endpoints and passage restrictions are review candidates that preserve the existing meaning, but time-based encounter and restart policies must be finalized separately. The old turn costs 750/1000/1250 for road, underground, and transfer are not reused as speed or distance.
Shared online campaign time has no pause, slowdown, or fast-forward usable by players. When the last player leaves, the world stops, and the wall-clock time elapsed while the world was empty is not caught up after reconnecting. A squad in combat receives no new movement commands until the result is settled. The calculator's battleLocked interval is a minimal proposal that suspends only that squad's progress while world time continues. Other squads do not stop, and combat does not monopolize world time. The five stance types, inherited/temporary squad leaders, hero/soldier separation, and the soldier maximum of 20 are retained.

오프라인 패킷은 임의정밀도 BigInt 곱셈과 정수 floor/ceil을: The offline packet uses arbitrary-precision BigInt multiplication and integer floor/ceil. External JSON numbers accept only safe non-negative integers, are rejected if they exceed the result limit, and are never clamped. Stable IDs are restricted to ASCII, and SHA-256 is applied to UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys. Arrays that are semantically sets, such as map nodes/edges, squad members, and commands, are sorted by explicit ID, while the order of route arrays is preserved. Duplicate IDs are rejected before hashing. Costs, coefficients, inputs, and results go into the hash; submission time, host order, and translations do not. The packet hash is not the Core replay hash.
동시 해결은 같은 턴 snapshot에서 검증해야 한다. 안정 저장순서를: Simultaneous resolution must be validated against the same turn snapshot. Stable storage order must not be used as a priority for deciding the game winner. Valid-route conflicts, crossing movement, information/ambush, dynamic blockades, and combat context require a separately approved conflictRuleVersion. The cumulative cost/budget rational-number time model is only a candidate under review and is neither adopted nor implemented in this document. Retransmission receipts, command DAGs, conflict resolution, stance transitions, and authenticity verification of approval records are also not included in the completion claim of this single-MOVE calculator.

Even when characters interpret events differently, the actual events and the settlement results must be consistent. Rewards and relationship changes must be grounded in witnessing, reporting, or participation. Only cases confirmed in the Seoul source material are adjudicated: in the Samseong Station roster and water contract, separate O Gyeongjae's position from Im Chowon's sealed testimony and unfinished maintenance training; Sin Jongmok's attempt to recover the transceiver unit is conditioned on the daily power supply that depends on the same part and on the residents' consent. Im Hajun's disappearance is not a death hook, and Bak Nuri's operational responsibility and O Gyeongjae's position as senior pastor are not automatically inherited by Im Chowon. It does not claim to reproduce actual historical blueprints, the existence of freight doors, or facility structures. There is room to use the three stations from the existing ToDo, but door states, convoys, and character reactions are proposals that need separate implementation. No new states, required leaders, or mystery answers are added.

At implementation review, existing cast members whose location, affiliation, position, life/death status, and relationships fit must be assigned. 성전, 교계 요청, 개종·신앙 창설·개혁 등: Holy wars, church requests, conversion, faith creation and reformation, etc.

단순히 자원을 지출했다고 그 자원에 대응하는 명성 단계가 같은 양으로 하: Simply spending a resource does not lower the corresponding renown level by the same amount. Cases where the act itself is judged dishonorable or impious are separate. Personal resources and shared dynasty resources must not be mixed.
**직할 한도 Domain Limit**: 통치자가 직접 보유할 수 있는: **Domain Limit**: The cap on how many holdings a ruler can hold directly. It varies with Stewardship skill, title rank, spousal support, perks, culture, and so on. The traditional base rule of `+1` domain limit per `6` Stewardship is a figure that needs version cross-checking.
**직할 초과**: 세금·징집병 효율에 불이익이 생긴다. 무한히 직접 보: **Exceeding the Domain Limit**: Penalties apply to tax and levy efficiency. This is why it is better to grant land to loyal vassals than to hold it all directly without limit. The latest per-excess-holding rate is unverified.
**개발도 Development**: 군사·경제 생산과 문화 혁신의 기반: **Development**: The foundation of military and economic output and cultural innovation. The known base effect for feudal and clan governments is `+0.5%` tax and levies per point of development, but government-specific exceptions and the latest figures are unverified.
**통제력 Control**: 백작령의 통치 집행 수준으로 보통 `0–1: **Control**: The level of governing enforcement in a county, usually `0–100`. It drops through occupation, revolt, and events, and is restored through Marshal tasks and the like. The known base rule is `-1%` tax and `-0.5%` levies for each point of control below 100, but the current application, caps, and special effects are unverified.
**건물**: 금을 선지출하고 건설 시간을 지나 세금·병력·보급·무장병: **Buildings**: Gold is paid up front, and after the construction time they yield effects such as taxes, troops, supplies, and men-at-arms garrisons. They are constrained by terrain, holding type, cultural innovations, and building slots and tiers. Men-at-arms garrison bonuses must not be mixed with the realm-wide building bonuses from launch.
**[추론: 경제 판단식]** `월 순수입 = 직할 수입 + 봉신 수입: **[Inference: economic judgment formula]** `wol sunsuip (monthly net income) = jikhal suip (direct income) + bongsin suip (vassal income) + gita jeonggi suip (other regular income) - gunbi (military expenses) - gungjeong·jikchaek·gita jeonggi biyong (court, office, and other regular costs)`. This is an accounting formula that describes the line items, not an engine formula that reproduces the order in which every game modifier is applied. The simple payback period of a construction is `geonseolbi (construction cost) / chuga wol sunsuip (additional monthly net income)`, but because it ignores ownership changes through death, conquest, and inheritance, it cannot be the whole basis for long-term decisions.
**봉건**: 봉신 계약이 세금과 징집병 의무를 정한다. 높은 의무는 일: **Feudal**: The vassal contract sets tax and levy obligations. Higher obligations generally lower vassal opinion, and changing them unfavorably without a pretext or a corresponding concession can create a tyranny problem. Special clauses such as wall, military service, and council rights are also subject to negotiation.
**씨족**: 초기 규칙에는 군주에 대한 의견이 세금·병력 기여에 직접: **Clan**: In the early rules, opinion of the ruler directly mattered for tax and troop contributions. Later rules introduced tax jurisdictions, tax collectors, and tax policies. The two systems must not be presented with the same current formula.
**부족**: 위신 단계가 봉신 기여와 통치 능력에 중요하고 일부 군비·: **Tribal**: Prestige level matters for vassal contributions and governing ability, and honor is spent instead of gold on some military and construction costs. Feudalization is a transition that changes the economic base and the structure of military costs.
**신정·공화 봉신**: 종교와 정부별 규칙으로 납부한다. 특히 성직자: **Theocratic and Republic Vassals**: They pay according to religion- and government-specific rules. In particular, distinguish faiths in which clergy support affects temple income from faiths in which the ruler holds temples directly.
**행정제·유목제·무토지**: 확장별 별도 경제·계승 체계가 있으므로 봉: **Administrative, Nomadic, and Landless**: Each has a separate economic and succession system by expansion, so the feudal contract formula must not be applied as is. The detailed figures for each have not been verified in this document.
4.4 비용은 고정표 하나로 끝나지 않는다 [미확인]: 4.4 Costs Do Not Reduce to a Single Fixed Table [Unverified]
선물은 대상의 지위·관련 보정에 따라 가격과 의견 효과가 달라진다. 명분: The price and opinion effect of a gift vary with the recipient's status and relevant modifiers. Completing a fabricated claim may require gold. Court positions and military upkeep are monthly maintenance costs. For mercenaries, the up-front contract cost and the contract duration are what matter, and bribing a scheme ally is a one-time cost. Therefore it is wrong to price every target the same, as in 'one scheme = 100 gold'.

Traits and modifiers affect skills, and health relates to the risk of death. Instead of a fixed party as in a tactical RPG, there is an overlapping network of characters across family, court, council, vassals, and army.[S21][S27][S31]

기본 다섯 생활방식은 각각 세 집중과 세 특전 트리를 제공한다. 선택한: Each of the five basic lifestyles provides three focuses and three perk trees. You gain experience in the chosen lifestyle, and spending perk points to unlock nodes along their prerequisites leads to the finished trait. Education traits, genius traits, and other effects affect experience gain. The known base values are `25` monthly experience, `1,000` experience per perk point, and a `5-year` wait to change focus, but they have not been cross-checked against the latest patch.
특전은 단순 `기량 +1`뿐 아니라 새로운 행동을 연다. 예를 들어 외교: Perks do more than a simple `+1 skill`; they open new actions. Examples include Diplomacy's befriend scheme, Stewardship's demanding gold in exchange for a pretext, Intrigue's abduction, and Learning's pretext for buying faith. The Prophet perk's `-50%` cost to create or reform a faith is a known representative effect, but the current value is unverified. 선천 특성은 유전 확률·강화·열성 전달을 가질 수 있다. 양쪽 부모가 같: Congenital traits can have inheritance probabilities, enhancement, and recessive transmission. Even if both parents have the same positive trait, a complete result is not guaranteed in every case.
교육 특성, 성격 특성, 선천 특성, 생활방식 완성 특성, 질병·부상·범: Education traits, personality traits, congenital traits, lifestyle-completion traits, and marks of disease, injury, and crime are separate categories.

Conquering a de jure duchy of another kingdom does not immediately change the de jure map. Long-term integration is affected by the conditions for de jure shifts and by tasks. When granting a title equal to or higher than one's liege's, the possibility of independence must be considered.

이 문서가 계정부터 사망·재입장까지 유저가 밟는 순서의 정본이다. 플레이: This document is the canonical source for the sequence a user follows, from account to death and re-entry. The stage where the player takes root is Seoul in 2126 CE, a century after the collapse began with the Great Blackout of 2030; the Prologue covers how it begins.
Active play takes place in **a world hosted by a headless authoritative server**. The Unity client connects over localhost to a bundled headless server child process, or to an optionally installed dedicated server of the same server format. Events caused by users and NPCs are recorded in that world's single ledger, and each participant is left with signed checkpoint receipts and projection metadata that can verify the current world and ledger position and preserve their own archive and bindings. Only when the checkpoint's immutable fork policy allows it are complete host-capable world snapshots distributed or exported; participants who are barred from forking are not given state complete enough to seed a server. After death without a valid designated successor, a new incarnation begins in **a new world**. The product session, hosting, and checkpoint contracts are defined by ADR-008.
플레이어는 국가나 세력이 아니다. **한 명의 살아 있는 세계 인물**이: The player is not a state or a faction. The player is **a single living figure of the world**. They may be a member of some group, or someone's son or daughter.
착생은 **무작위**와 **커스텀** 두 갈래다. 둘 다 같은 월드에 들: Incarnation has two paths: **Random** and **Custom**. Both enter the same world.
[원정](rules/Campaign-Loop.md)은 입장 **이후**의: [Expedition](rules/Campaign-Loop.md) is the session loop **after** entry. It does not replace account, incarnation, or shared entry.

A **session** is a connection credential and is volatile. Occupancy of a **figure (`personId`)** and the world–figure binding are kept in checkpoints. The **archive** is the play and death record kept locally by the participant, and the host world holds the original.
Accounts, incarnation, lineage checkpoints, and the headless authoritative server do not exist yet.

서울을 한 나라로 모으는 결말만 두지 않는다. 노선 연합, 독립 역, 강: We do not provide only an ending that gathers Seoul into a single nation. Line alliances, independent stations, Lectern Rule, trade networks, technological restoration. The legitimacy built through play becomes the order.
RPG는 인물의 역량·행동 숙련·특성과 관계를 통해 진행된다. 통솔·전략: The RPG progresses through a character's abilities, action proficiencies, traits, and relationships. The base abilities of leadership, strategy, negotiation, management, insight, learning, skill, and stamina range from 0–20, and 10 is the level of an experienced practitioner in that field. The final ability, reflecting traits, items, and current condition, ranges from 0–100 and never exceeds 100 under any effect. Action proficiencies such as repair, medicine, transport, escort, negotiation, and exploration are expressed separately from abilities, from 0–99.9. Traits are gained through events and actions, and traits affect performance, choices, stress, and relationships. Opening effects with a narrative basis may allow final abilities above 20. The specific formulas for resolution, growth, and effect composition will be designed separately, and previously issued values are not automatically converted.
전투는 붙기 전에 부대를 편성하고 지시한다. 붙은 뒤에는 병사 한 사람: In combat, you organize and instruct your units before engagement. Once engaged, each individual soldier's attacks are resolved, and a squad in melee engagement does not receive new orders. You do not directly input combos for individual heroes. [Combat](rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md). The body is resolved in six parts: left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head, and torso. Damage level and functional state are distinguished for each part, and disease progression is recorded separately. Combat and plague affect the same bodily state. Limited or lost function in a part affects the livelihoods and actions available, and prosthetics are fitted only after amputation.
이름 있는 영웅은 병졸 분대와 분리되며 병졸 수에 포함되지 않는다. 부대: Named heroes are separate from rank-and-file squads and are not counted in the troop total. Unit size varies with the commander's personal stats, the level of the state, and the level of the settlement, and there is no universal cap. Input definitions and formulas are undecided. There is also no fixed cap on overall army size or the number of heroes; supply, overextension, and the number of hero commanders limit scale.
무공·초식·유파 등 무협 체계는 사용하지 않는다. 이에 의존한 조직과 제: The wuxia system of martial arts, forms, and schools is not used. Organizations and institutions that depended on it are redesigned to fit governance, livelihoods, religion, the military, and community management. Strategy and leadership are an organization's planning and command, while skill is judgment and execution in individual combat. Heroic powerhouses are allowed, but high personal combat power does not automatically grant command, troops, equipment, or intelligence. A character's public profile explains their abilities and traits through their actual life, actions, and relationships.
The strategic map covers two layers within Seoul's administrative boundary: the surface and the real subway. Directly acquiring or manipulating territory outside Seoul is excluded from the current goals. Details of movement and layer connections within Seoul are undecided. The combat camera is a 3D free command view with pan, orbit, and zoom, and no angle or FOV values are set. The top-down diagram is a blueprint for explaining space, not the actual in-game render. There is no pause, slow-down, or speed-up in combat. Target characters are rendered with natural, realistic proportions and restrained expressions, using flat colors, outlines, and hatching. The original bytes of existing donated assets are preserved.

The collapse began with the Great Blackout of 2030, and that night is recorded in the prologue. The game is set in 2126 CE, a century later. The order the campaign depicts is a line society split by what people watch over and by faith. The player is a nobody. Being a nobody is only one rooting path. Follow the [Online User Journey](Online-User-Journey.md) for the full sequence. Starting with a small party, you move between stations and lines, building livelihood, relationships, rank, and influence within factions.

Before engagement, the player deploys squads and directs movement, attack targets, fire, and ambushes, but gives no new orders to squads in melee engagement. Retreat is a battle-wide command. Characters aim for natural, realistic proportions, restrained expressions, and low-saturation flat colors, outlines, and hatching. Livelihood, subsistence, production, logistics, marriage, diplomacy, technology transfer, and mobilization are within the design scope of being linked through the same characters and world time, and are not yet implemented.

No angle or FOV values are set. There is no pause, slow-down, or speed-up in combat, and the campaign world and other parties continue to flow regardless of the battle. Orders are previewed on squads before engagement and then confirmed, and squads in melee engagement receive no new orders. Retreat is a battle-wide command. There is no command queue. The original bytes of the Odland assets are preserved.

Use the common name of equipment, such as the lens, and action names, such as aiming and reconnaissance, according to their function. 한자어는 한글로 적는다. `감응조준법`, `호위철벽진`, `척후`처럼 읽: Sino-Korean words are written in Hangul. The reader should be able to guess the meaning, as with `gameungjojunbeop` (sympathetic-response aiming method), `howicheolbyeokjin` (guard iron-wall formation), and `cheokhu` (scout).
한자는 동음어 구별이나 어원 설명이 필요한 첫 등장에만 괄호로 병기할 수: Hanja may be added in parentheses only at first appearance, where distinguishing homonyms or explaining etymology is necessary. Do not repeat Hanja in every heading and table.
사전에 있거나 한국어 전문 분야에서 통용되는 낱말을 우선한다. 낱말을 이: Prefer words that appear in dictionaries or are in common use in specialized Korean fields. Even if words are joined together, do not use the result if its full meaning cannot be explained in one sentence.
`신공`, `절맥`, `천광`처럼 실제 효과보다 초월성을 암시하는 말은: Words such as `singong`, `jeolmaek`, and `cheongwang`, which imply transcendence more than an actual effect, are used only when the corresponding setting exists. Do not exaggerate abilities for the sake of atmosphere.
중국어·일본어 고유 문파명과 무공명을 한자음으로만 바꿔 창작명처럼 쓰지: Do not simply convert Chinese or Japanese proper names of schools and martial arts into Sino-Korean readings and use them as original creations.
For loanwords, use the Hangul spelling by default and do not repeat the original-language spelling in body text. Machine identifiers and source names are exceptions.
프로젝트 표기는 `피지컬 에이아이`, `휴머노이드`, `아틀라스`, `센: Project notation follows the Hangul spellings that are already locked, such as `pijikeol eiai` (Physical AI), `hyumeonoideu` (humanoid), `atteullaseu` (Atlas), `senseo` (sensor), `renjeu` (lens), `modyul` (module), and `peurotokol` (protocol).
작품명·기업명·제품명은 사실 출처를 밝히는 조사 층에서만 쓴다. 2126: Names of works, companies, and products are used only in the research layer that states factual sources. Do not revive them as names of organizations, schools, or products created for the year 2126.
원어의 약자를 그대로 읽기 어려울 때는 한글 정식명 뒤 데이터 설명에서만: When an abbreviation of the original language is hard to read as is, give it only in the data description after the official Hangul name. Do not leave a bare abbreviation in the UI.
역사적 인물·지명·사건·무술·일반명처럼 법적 문제가 없고 상표로 보호되지: Factual names that raise no legal issues and are not protected as trademarks, such as historical figures, place names, events, martial arts, and generic names, are used as they are for realism. Do not apply automatic substitution just to avoid real names.
상표 검색 결과가 없다는 사실만으로 안전을 단정하지 않는다. 상업 출시용: Do not conclude that a name is safe merely because a trademark search found no results. For proper names intended for commercial release, record the target countries, goods/services classes, rights status, search date, and evidence URLs in the rights ledger.
저작권은 이름 자체보다 작품 속 창작 표현·설명·문장·캐릭터 구성·고유: Review copyright separately from the name itself, looking at creative expression, descriptions, sentences, character composition, and distinctive technical depictions within a work. Do not change historical facts or generic martial arts names because of copyright.
실제 조직명은 사실 층에서 그대로 쓸 수 있다. 다만 현재 실존 조직을: Real organization names may be used as they are in the factual layer. However, any use that makes a currently existing organization the perpetrator of fictional crimes, massacres, or conspiracies, or that could be mistaken for an official successor, must go through a separate review of rights, reputation, and confusion.
창작 조직은 하는 일과 권한이 이름에서 드러나야 한다. 실제 기관의 범죄: Fictional organizations should have names that reveal what they do and what authority they hold. Do not use names that read like criminal successors of real institutions.
직책은 16국의 현대 기관별 명칭과 공통 티어를 구분한다. 조선 관직을: Titles distinguish the modern institution-specific designations of the 16 nations from the common tiers. Do not use Joseon-era official titles as an intermediate translation layer.
훈련·숙련은 실제 수행하는 행동으로 명명한다. 조직 이름이나 직책을 개인: Name training and proficiency after the actions actually performed. Do not use organization names or titles as personal abilities, and do not create names or promotion systems for martial arts, techniques, or schools.
역량·숙련·특성·부위 상태의 표시명은 각각의 의미를 구분한다. 개인 전투: Keep the display names for competence, proficiency, traits, and body-part status distinct in meaning. Do not group individual combat skill, unit deployment, production work, and administrative authority under the same name or suffix system.
`/gdd` 표와 데이터 사전은 한국어 표시명, 안정된 기계 ID, 자료: The `/gdd` tables and the data dictionary list the Korean display name, stable machine ID, data type, unit, allowed range, default value, source, and confirmation status separately.
영웅 클래스·캠페인 역할·이동 태세 같은 설계어는 GDD가 소유한다. 인: The GDD owns design terms such as hero classes, campaign roles, and movement stances. The wiki owns characters' life stories and in-world nicknames.
값이 정해지지 않았으면 `미정`과 결정 주체를 적는다. 흔한 게임 수치를: If a value has not been decided, write `mijeong` (undecided) and the party who decides it. Do not fill in common game values as arbitrary defaults.
CSV와 JSON의 영어 키는 교환 계약이다. 위키·GDD 본문과 UI에: English keys in CSV and JSON are an exchange contract. Provide Korean display names in the wiki, GDD body text, and UI.

It is released only when the participant explicitly gives it up. A host kick blocks rejoining, but it does not release the occupancy or erase the character's record.
재참가 신원은 월드 참가자 복구 비밀이다. 비밀을 잃으면 호스트가 게임: The rejoin identity is the world participant's recovery secret. If the secret is lost, the host can reissue it after confirming the person outside the game, and the old secret is revoked. There is no automatic in-game identity proof.

플레이어는 빈 지휘관을 밖에서 들고 오지 않는다. 이미 있는 후세 서울의: The player does not bring in a blank commander from outside. The player becomes **one person** who already exists in the Seoul of the later age.

이름 있는 personId는 살아 있는 계정 하나다. 직위로 예외를 두지: A named personId is one living account. No exception is made for rank. The Character Compendium, the cast of characters, and kin created during incarnation all fall under this.
두 계정이 같은 personId를 선택하면 두 번째 점유 요청을 거절한다: If two accounts choose the same personId, the second occupancy request is rejected. An unlocked character is not assigned as a substitute, and random reselection does not widen product eligibility.
The world picks one seat that is currently empty.

A personId that is already occupied is removed from the draw.

The random additional roster is an NPC candidate experiment. It is not an incarnation register.
The player writes the background directly. The fields follow the character card contract.
기존 프리셋의 공통 생성. 이것만으로는 착생이 끝나지 않는다: The common creation step of the existing presets. This alone does not complete incarnation.

커스텀은 이미 점유한 personId를 덮어쓰지 않는다. 덮어쓰기 요청은: Custom does not overwrite a personId that is already occupied. An overwrite request is rejected.
부모는 살아 있는 세계 인물이거나 「없음」이다. 「없음」이면 무명 가지다: The parent is either a living world character or "None." If "None," the character is a nameless branch.
다른 유저의 personId를 부모로 고를 수 있다. 자식은 새 pers: A player can choose another user's personId as a parent. The child is a new personId. Two accounts do not occupy the parent seat together.
If the character chosen as parent is alive, that relationship is created in the ledger as a single line.
시작 프리셋 여섯 종은 **난이도(무엇이 없는가)** 다. 신분을 대신하: The six starting presets are **difficulties (what is missing)**. They do not replace identity.
순서: 착생(누구인가) → 프리셋(무엇으로 시작하는가). 예: 구로 군벌: Order: incarnation (who you are) → preset (what you start with). Example: after incarnating as the son of a Guro warlord, you choose the "Deserter Platoon" scarcity. The "commander" in the preset table is a role within the party, not a blank body made outside the world.
If the bloodline or affiliation from incarnation conflicts with a starting preset's long-term rules, incarnation wins. The conflict is recorded in the ledger as a single line. This document does not modify the preset table.
The current sentence that creates only name, gender, and appearance becomes part of this stage.
시작 프리셋은 캠페인 동안 유지되는 장기 규칙이며, 시작 직후 사라지는: A starting preset is a long-term rule that persists throughout the campaign, not a bonus that disappears right after the start.
Starting companions are placed randomly from the world's Character Compendium under each preset's conditions.
프리셋의 시작 인원 3~6명은 캠페인 파티의 크기이며, 병사 분대 정원이: The preset's starting headcount of 3 to 6 is the size of the campaign party, not the size of a soldier squad or an army corps.
When incarnation ends, that character appears in the later-age Seoul that is **already in progress**.
한 월드의 캠페인은 하나다. 헤드리스 서버의 월드가 그 월드이고, 재접속: A world has one campaign. The headless server's world is that world, and on reconnection, once the participant binding is confirmed with the recovery secret, the player is shown the current world from the verified checkpoint.
세계 시간은 플레이어가 한 명 이상 연결되어 있을 때만 흐른다. 단위는: World time flows only while at least one player is connected. Its units are the days and weeks of the [Expedition](rules/Campaign-Loop.md). When the headcount reaches 0, the server writes and publishes a verified checkpoint and then stops the world and NPC simulation.
Routes, strongholds, deaths, and treaties changed by other users are visible.
오프라인 점유 인물은 세계 안의 일상·정치 NPC로 남는다. 원정을 시작: An offline occupied character remains in the world as a daily-life and political NPC. It cannot start an expedition or make decisions reserved for players. It can be wounded or killed. Rank signatures and official documents are handled only through the ambition-driven NPC politics.
틱은 헤드리스 권위 서버가 굴린다(ADR-008). Steam과 cron: Ticks are run by the headless authoritative server (ADR-008). Steam and cron do not run the simulation on its behalf. The cloud does not keep world time running continuously.

제품 목표 전투는 개인 판정이다. 영웅 직접 조작은 포함하지 않고 교전: The product-goal combat is personal resolution. It does not include direct hero control and follows pre-engagement orders, melee lock, and whole-battle retreat.
플레이어는 국가가 아니라 지금 조종하는 살아 있는 한 인물이다. 캠페인: The player is not a nation but the one living person they currently control. The campaign viewpoint is bound to that person's location and known information (PR #213).

No local QA server will be built. Review follows the remote build.

전략 태세는 통상 행군·강행군·매복·주둔·야영 다섯이다. 회복·보급 수치: There are five strategic stances: Normal March, Forced March, Ambush, Garrison, and Encamp. Recovery and supply values are not decided (OD-STANCE, owner decision of 2026-09-24).

생활·관계·생계·생산·물류·혼인·외교·기술 전승·동원·습격을 전투와 이동: The design scope connects daily life, relationships, livelihood, production, logistics, marriage, diplomacy, technology transmission, mobilization, and raids to combat and movement (Decision 15 of 2026-10-02). The player is not a state but a single person, who gains authority to act through an occupation, an office, and confirmation. Shortages in daily life change labor and mood, and the results of production and supply lead to loyalty, war, and succession. Injury and detention carry over into labor and relationships. What follows is a plan that distinguishes the scope already reflected from the inputs still undecided; it does not mean the game has been fully implemented. The strategy map's viewpoint follows the location and known information of the main-body character selected from the map list. The default display layer is the factions' political territory, showing diplomacy, domains, titles, offices, the political situation, and the combat situation. Subway and railway lines are an optional display layer and are off by default. The settlement screen shows the settlement where the main body is actually present, and direct on-site control targets only the main body. Other characters act according to their own goals, livelihoods, and schedules, and can be the target of conversation and orders. Affiliated faction, relationship edges, and physical location are separate things. The list is read from the actual character, faction, and relationship ledgers, and affiliation or relationship alone does not grant cohabitation or command authority. If there is no current location, it is left as unconfirmed, and a scenario placement is not fixed as the opening location.

세력 그래프의 꼭짓점은 통치자와 공개 종파와 숨은 신앙과 유물 정통성과: The vertices of the faction graph are rulers, public denominations, hidden faiths, relic legitimacy, and consumption rites. The edges are denominational coordination, syncretic valves, relic recognition, rite sharing, hostility, and passage. Progress is measured not by occupied tiles but by the stability and legitimacy of this graph.
침입과 주간 위기는 꼭짓점을 바로 지우지 않습니다. 변을 접거나 숨기거나: Incursions and weekly crises do not erase vertices directly. First they fold or hide edges, or move their expiry weeks earlier. If a ruler is captured or killed, a dynastic succession issue opens. State objects are never deleted.
한 주에 침입이 그래프를 바꾸는 축은 세 가지입니다. 종파 조정·혼합주의: There are three axes along which an incursion can change the graph in a single week. Denominational coordination and syncretism split and re-attach doctrine layers or raise hidden faiths. Relic legitimacy moves the custody station of a debris relic or withdraws its recognition. Consumption rites suspend rationing, lamp-lighting, and balance-settling rites, or replace them with another denomination's rites. When several changes occur in the same week, the dedicated random result is fixed first, and then they are scheduled in crisis ID order.
외부 충격이 거점을 치면 그 거점의 공개 종파가 혼합 밸브를 하나 엽니다: When an external shock hits a node, that node's public denomination opens one syncretic valve. The valve borrows one line of doctrine from the source node for a limited term. When the loan expires, a hidden-faith vertex appears or the existing denomination splits. An incursion alone does not change the names of faith families or individual faiths.
유물이 약탈되거나 의례가 끊기면 정통성 `L_i`를 다시 셉니다. 연결: When a relic is plundered or a rite is broken off, legitimacy `L_i` is recounted. Connectivity `K_i` is trimmed again to the maximum path reliability after the passage edge is cut. The tension `E'` and crisis probability formulas remain unchanged. The path of stabilization, specialization, line projection, and order charter after occupation also remains unchanged. No stage is added to the six-stage loop.
연표의 사건은 정해진 결과를 재생하지 않습니다. 사건은 조건을 열고, 결: Events on the timeline do not replay a fixed outcome. An event opens conditions, and the outcome is decided by the ambitions, fears, relationships, memories, and positions of living characters. If a key figure dies, is captured, or is persuaded, another character can lead the same event and produce a different result.

선택 자격·시작 위치는 원천과 승인 상태를 검사한다. 본체 ID는 시작: Eligibility for selection and the starting location are checked against the source and approval status. The player character ID does not change through target selection after the start. The world clock and game HUD are activated after the game starts.
전략맵은 외교·영지·작위·정세·전투 상황을 읽는다. 정치·작위·지상·지하: The strategy map shows diplomacy, domains, titles, political conditions, and combat situations. Political, title, surface, and underground modes are kept separate.
국가명·국가색은 공통 지배 표시다. 작위·지표·역 통제는 별도 데이터층이: Nation names and nation colors are the common display of control. Titles, indicators, and station control are separate data layers, and the control color does not create rights in other layers. Administrative boundaries and territorial boundaries are distinguished.
실제 다음 역 인접 연결을 사용하고 급행의 중간역 건너뛰기 운행을 이동: Use actual adjacent next-station connections, and do not turn express services that skip intermediate stations into movement edges.
운행 계통·물리 연결·통행 상태를 분리한다. 미확인 연결은 표시·이동을: Separate the service line, the physical connection, and the passage status. Unverified connections allow neither display nor movement, and leave the source ID, version, and verification status.
소속·관계·현재 소재지는 서로 다른 사실이다. 같은 장소의 인물만 정착지: Affiliation, relationships, and current location are different facts. Only characters at the same location appear in a settlement.
세력 구성원·관계인은 원격 조회할 수 있으나 조회·선택이 이동·동거·지휘: Faction members and related persons can be looked up remotely, but looking up or selecting them does not imply movement, cohabitation, or command authority. An unrecorded location remains unconfirmed.
본체 한 인물만 직접 조작한다. NPC는 목표·욕구·업무·휴식 일정을 따: Only the one player character is controlled directly. NPCs act autonomously according to their goals, desires, work, and rest schedules.
대상 선택 ID와 본체 ID를 분리한다. 명령·대화는 행위자 권한·관계: Separate the target selection ID from the player character ID. Commands and conversations check the actor's authority, relationship type, direction, location, distance, current schedule, and reason for refusal.
조우 사건이 전투를 만든다. 본체 실제 참가전만 전장을 표시하며 정착지: An encounter event creates combat. Only combat in which the player character actually participates displays a battlefield, and it is incompatible with the settlement screen.

Check participant positions, labor reservations, and the result ID, and settle only once.

인물 선택은 지도에 고정된 초상 카드와 선택 상세, 관계·세력은 본체 중: Character selection is shown with portrait cards fixed to the map and a selection detail panel, and relationships and factions are shown as ledger nodes and directed edges centered on the player character.
카드 팬·줌·화면밖 제외는 지도 좌표를 보존한다. 관계를 추정 생성하지: Card pan, zoom, and off-screen exclusion preserve map coordinates. Relationships are not generated by inference. The player character's local marker masks the registered portrait in a circle, and unregistered characters are displayed as unregistered.
왕국·공작령·백작령·남작령별 영역·보유자·상위 작위 입력 장소를 마련하고: Provide input locations for the territory, holder, and superior title of each kingdom, duchy, county, and barony, and enter them after the wiki confirms them.
국가나 행정구역을 임의 작위령에 배정하지 않는다. 빈 원장·참조 오류·상: Do not assign nations or administrative districts arbitrarily to title domains. Check for empty ledgers, reference errors, superior-title cycles, and duplicate assignments, and display effective control and title rights separately.
타국 관계인 선택→본체 ID와 현재 장소 유지, 명령 권한 없는 계약 상: Selecting a related person from another nation → the player character ID and current location are kept, and a command to a contract partner without command authority is refused.
본체 여행 중 정착지 진입 거절→도착 뒤 새 소재지의 인물만 표시. 구성: Refuse entry to a settlement while the player character is traveling → after arrival, display only characters at the new location. Looking up members does not increase population or labor reservations.
본체 미참가전 전장 진입 거절·전략 자동 정산, 본체 참가전 정착지 진입: Refuse battlefield entry for combat the player character does not participate in and settle it automatically at the strategy level; refuse settlement entry for combat the player character participates in, return after the result, and refuse duplicate results.

All living opening characters are selectable regardless of affiliation or rank (owner-confirmed). Detailed restrictions such as age and detention are not yet decided, and the current POC's adult filter is not adopted as a product restriction. Selecting a different target does not change main body occupancy.
현지→출발 예약→이동 중→도착/중단→현지·구금·전투 참가: On site → departure reserved → in transit → arrived/interrupted → on site, detained, or participating in combat
출발·도착 사건으로 현재 장소를 갱신한다. 경로 이동 중 다른 정착지에: Departure and arrival events update the current location. A character in transit along a route does not exist in another settlement at the same time. A request to look up or summon an associated person does not imply arrival.
작성→권한 검사→전달 중→대상 수신→수락/보류/거절→예약→실행→완료/취소: Drafted → authority check → in delivery → received by target → accepted/deferred/refused → reserved → executed → completed/canceled
지휘권 유형·방향·위임 범위·실제 연락 경로·대상 상태를 검사한다. 원격: Checks the command type, direction, scope of delegation, the actual contact channel, and the target's state. A remote command is delivered by whatever means are available, such as couriers, radio, or contact networks, and is executed after the target receives and accepts it (owner-confirmed). If it conflicts with needs, goals, or an existing schedule, the deferral, refusal, or negotiation is recorded, and a command does not automatically erase personal goals. The delivery time and the detailed values for acceptance checks and priority are undecided.
대상 조회→현지/연락 가능 검사→상호작용→인물/계약 사건: Target lookup → on-site/contactable check → interaction → character/contract event
조회가 지휘권을 만들지 않는다. 먼 장소·구금·전투·연락 두절의 접근 조: A lookup does not create command authority. Access conditions for distant locations, detention, combat, and lost contact differ by interaction. Direct control is not granted over every member of the same faction.
목표·욕구·역할 평가→가능 행동 선택→자원/시간 예약→이동/행동→결과→재: Evaluate goals, needs, and roles → select a possible action → reserve resources/time → move/act → result → re-evaluate
능력·도구·권한·건강·위치에 맞는 행동만 실행한다. 안전·생리·구금 같은: Only actions that fit the character's abilities, tools, authority, health, and location are executed. Impossible conditions such as safety, physiological needs, and detention take priority, and deferral, refusal, or negotiation of commands is recorded according to loyalty, relationships, authority, and the existing schedule (owner-confirmed). The check values and the action-selection algorithm are undecided. Releasing the existing reservation and acquiring the new one in a schedule change are recorded as a single transition.
집계 구성원→개인 ID에 대응하는 개인화→역할/예약 변경→집계/개인 합산: Aggregate members → individualization mapped to individual IDs → role/reservation change → aggregate/individual sum
개인화는 인구 생성이 아니다. 개인화된 인원을 집계 가용 노동에서도 다시: Individualization is not population creation. Individualized people are not counted again in aggregate available labor. Birth, death, migration, and capture are population/personnel events, not representation transitions.
가용→시설/운송/부대/치료 예약→수행→완료/부상/중단→복귀 가능 검사: Available → facility/transport/unit/treatment reservation → performance → completed/injured/interrupted → return eligibility check
한 사람의 같은 시간 구간을 겹치는 역할에 예약하지 않는다. 직능 부재·: A person is not reserved for overlapping roles in the same time interval. Absence of skills, absence of equipment, travel, and injury are different from available labor. Returning does not create a new character or reactivate the reservations of the dead.
소비 권리/예약→배정→실제 지급/도착→소비→충족/부족→다음 행동 제약: Consumption right/reservation → allocation → actual issuance/arrival → consumption → satisfied/short → constraints on next actions
배급 수령과 구매 수요를 중복하지 않는다. 부족에 따른 동일 노동 손실을: Receiving rations and purchase demand are not duplicated. The same labor loss caused by shortage is not applied twice, in livelihood and in the economy. Satisfaction is recorded as a state separate from mood, loyalty, and T.
인구 500명의 5명을 개인화하고 3명을 소집해도 총인구는 그대로이며 해: Even if 5 of a population of 500 are individualized and 3 are mobilized, the total population stays the same, and they are not duplicated in facility/aggregate labor for that time. When 1 injured person is treated and returns, the existing ID and reservations are carried over. The numbers are validation inputs.
타국 계약 상대·동일 세력 무지휘 대상·지휘 위임 만료 대상에 명령을 보: When a command is sent to a contract counterpart of another state, a non-commanded target of the same faction, or a target whose command delegation has expired, the authority check results are distinguished. Review cancellation/deferral for a base relocation before the command is received, a severed contact channel, and target detention.
개인화와 생산 마감·소집과 치료·도착과 소비가 같은 세계 시간에 발생하면: If individualization and production deadlines, mobilization and treatment, or arrival and consumption occur at the same world time, reservations and totals are replayed by acceptance order and causal events. Reapplying the same event does not increase population, supplies, or available labor.
누적 결정과 남은 전투 제안: Accumulated Decisions and Remaining Combat Proposals
이동은 거리·수단·상태, 현재 정보는 관측·보고, 탐사 보상은 정보·기회: Movement is fixed by distance, means, and state; current information by observation and reports; exploration rewards by information and opportunities. Construction consumes actual resources by stage, production follows demand and reserved orders, and cargo includes verified arrivals up to the deadline time. Effective control and recognition are separated from title rights, and excess personnel are preserved when the quota is reduced. Marriage by state, termination by effect, education by technology, separate claim actions by spouse claims, child inheritance, succession, and authorized handlers, and the need for a casus belli in every war are applied. Specific coefficients, times, and costs, as well as unassigned institutions/titles, are undecided.
The local commander decides based on the prior objective, posture, and authority, together with observed information, capabilities, and goals.
원격 지시 전달·수락과 근접 잠금, 자동/수동 동일 실행 판정·단일 결과: Remote instruction delivery and acceptance, close-range locks, identical resolution for automatic and manual execution, and a single result ledger are maintained. The detailed policy function is undecided.
작전력·독자 계산식 — 범위 확정: Operational Strength and Original Formula — Scope Final
기본 개인 능력·판정을 출발점으로 개인 명중/방어/피해/부상 재설계, 지: Starting from the basic individual abilities and checks, all three scopes are designed: redesign of individual hit/defense/damage/injury, command, supply, and battlefield modifiers, and unit aggregate calculation.
단순 추정 지표만으로 확정하지 않는다. 실제 함수·계수·집계 피해 배분·: It is not finalized on simple estimated metrics alone. The actual functions, coefficients, aggregate damage distribution, and application channels are undecided, and applying the same loss twice to individuals and aggregates is prohibited.
Joins after actual arrival that satisfies the reinforcement conditions and entry route set at the start.
본체 실제 편입 뒤 현장 화면 접근을 갱신하며 정착지와 배타. 이미 종료: After the main body is actually incorporated, field screen access is updated, and it is exclusive with settlements. It does not join a session that has already ended or retroactively apply past damage.
앞서 미응답 제안으로 관리한 항목은 2026-10-03 소유자 추가 응답: Items previously managed as unanswered proposals were finalized up to the scope above by the owner's additional response on 2026-10-03. The calculation coefficients, algorithms, and detailed reinforcement conditions are still undecided, and prototype runtime values are not finalized as they are. The individual-check combat and strategy–combat round-trip documents own the execution/settlement contracts.
이 장은 서울 사실·CK3 참조·제품 권한을 분리한다. 참조 게임의 제도: This chapter separates Seoul facts, CK3 references, and product authority. The institutions and numbers of the reference game are not promoted to Seoul rules. An approved contract does not mean implementation is complete, and the replacement scope of SP-1.0.0 takes precedence over past shared-world clauses.
외부 제품 원천: https://github.com/islee23520/: External product source: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/tree/main (measured revision 3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53; citations use fixed-revision URLs). The CK3 evidence files are survey receipts from 2026-10-27 and are not build inputs. The integrity of that installation is unverified. Source paths and identifiers are survey notations and are not game UI display names.
서울 사실: SP-1.0.0의 한 플레이어·한 본체·NPC·단일 캠페인: Seoul fact: Follows SP-1.0.0's one player, one main body, NPCs, and single-campaign save. Heroes are actors separate from foot soldiers (https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/AGENTS.md#L54-L62). What was confirmed on 2026-09-24 in the existing hero squad contract is a catalog of 1,004 heroes and six main combat classes: Guardian, Breakthrough, Staff, Relief, Scout, and Camp Follower. A combat class is not the same as a campaign role, rank, or command authority. Individual character lives are owned by LORE/WIKI and are not duplicated in this chapter.
서울 사실: SP-1.0.0 본체·공통 실행 계약과 인물 시트 계약을 상: Seoul fact: References the SP-1.0.0 main body and common execution contract and the character sheet contract as parent documents. Abilities are recorded by distinguishing qualification, execution, and performance, and numbers are not generated from a class name alone. CK3 reference: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:44-77,175-257 shows the structure of skill and experience multipliers for education traits and lifestyle/perk links. Experience thresholds and growth speed are not Seoul rules. Product authority: the original skill list, experience curve, and ability modifier coefficients are undecided institutions.
1.3 특성·건강·욕구·기분·스트레스: 1.3 Traits, Health, Needs, Mood, and Stress
CK3 참조: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:78: CK3 reference: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:78-94,125-173 shows the structure of mutually exclusive personalities and stress-threshold events. Since stress was not observed before the command, previous values are not back-calculated from add_stress observations. The coping link in depth-01-social-intrigue.md:1156-1203 is a corrected static reference, cited only within the depth-verification-20261027.md:1855-1900 PASS scope, and is not an adopted rule. Product authority: Seoul's trait, needs, and stress institutions and numbers are undecided institutions. The existing approved health and injury contract is not replaced by a new CK3 stress scale.
1.4 생활·일과와 현실 원인: 1.4 Livelihood, Daily Routine, and Real-World Causes
서울 사실: 기존 영웅 분대 승인 계약은 마법 같은 체감을 사기·의술·선: Seoul fact: The existing approved hero squad contract explains magic-like effects through the real-world causes of fraud, medicine, agitation, equipment, information, and physical AI skills, and does not make supernatural magic a default cause. Livelihood actions follow SP-1.0.0's proposal → qualification → acceptance → reservation → execution → receipt. Product authority: livelihood content, routine frequency, and recovery amounts are undecided institutions, and arbitrary periodic processing is not added before the CH5 activities and CH9 time model are closed.

보존 계약과 결정 번호의 소유: Ownership of Preservation Contracts and Decision Numbers
제품 결정 13(개인 판정 전투)·14(시간 기반 전략 이동)·15(가변: Product Decisions 13 (individual-check combat), 14 (time-based strategic movement), and 15 (variable quota) are owner decisions preserved in the approved rules documents below. They are in a different namespace from the mechanism D13/D14/D15 sheet numbers and do not approve the proposal sheet. SP-1.0.0 replaces the shared-world, participant, host, occupancy, and online-proxy clauses with historical scope, and maintains the contracts for actual movement, on-site participation, authority, single settlement, and save errors. pw-01 is a war-initiation threshold proposal, not an approved product decision number.
결정 14·15 및 영웅 클래스 승인 원장: Approval Ledger for Decisions 14 and 15 and Hero Classes
결정 13·15 및 개인·상황·집계 계산 책임: Decisions 13 and 15 and Responsibility for Individual, Situational, and Aggregate Calculation
목표 인물의 제거·부상·포획·폭로 시도: Attempts to eliminate, wound, capture, or expose a target
목표 상태, 발각, 보복·법적 결과: Target status, detection, retaliation, and legal consequences
노선·시설·보급·피지컬 에이아이 인터페이스의 방해 또는 확보: Disruption or securing of routes, facilities, supplies, and Physical AI interfaces
자산 상태, 증거, 수리·대응 경로: Asset status, evidence, and repair/response paths
정찰, 지도 작성, 사실 확인, 허위 정보 반박: Reconnaissance, mapping, fact-checking, and rebutting disinformation
범위, 최신성, 출처 신뢰도, 공개 결과: Scope, freshness, source reliability, and public outcome
강한 전투 영웅이 자동으로 외교·암살·방해 공작·정보 활동에 능한 것은: A strong combat hero is not automatically good at diplomacy, assassination, sabotage, or intelligence operations. Campaign roles are assigned separately from combat classes.
A strategic squad that can move needs one formal hero commander.
부대 정원은 지휘관의 승인된 독자 기량·국가 수준·정착지 수준 입력에 따: Unit capacity depends on the commander's approved individual skill, nation-level, and settlement-level inputs, and there is no common cap. The skill input definitions and formula are undecided. Hero commanders and attached heroes are not counted toward the rank-and-file headcount. There are no fixed caps on the number of squads, heroes, or legion size; supply, overextension, and the number of hero commanders limit scale.
영웅 한 명은 한 시점에 하나의 상태만 가진다: 지휘관, 배속, 독립 요: A hero has only one status at a time: commander, attached, independent agent, or unavailable.
플레이어 본체 영웅은 정확히 한 분대에만 속한다. 플레이어 위치는 그 분: The player's main-body hero belongs to exactly one squad. The player's position is calculated from that squad's position, and no separate position value is kept.
본체 영웅이 죽거나 영구 구금되면 지정 후계, 없으면 계승 순서의 인물이: If the main-body hero dies or is permanently detained, the designated successor becomes the new main body; if there is none, the next person in the order of succession does. If there is no successor, that character is finished. The player's viewpoint moves to the new main body's location, and the remaining squad elects a temporary squad leader from among its rank-and-file troops. The new main body can command that squad remotely.
플레이어는 본체 위치와 무관하게 자신이 소유한 모든 영웅 분대의 전략 명: Regardless of where the main body is, the player directly confirms strategic orders remotely for every hero squad they own. This authority does not cause the main body to exist in multiple places at once.
분리·합류는 같은 층과 같은 노드에서 전투·요격이 열리지 않은 상태에서만: Splitting and merging are possible only on the same floor and at the same node, and only when no combat or interception has opened. After a merge, the capacity contract of the commander, nation, and settlement is checked. Until the formula is finalized, no arbitrary fixed headcount is used as a substitute.
지휘관을 잃으면 병졸 중 한 명을 임시 분대장으로 선출한다. 임시 분대장: If the commander is lost, one of the rank-and-file troops is elected as a temporary squad leader. The temporary squad leader can issue the same orders as a formal hero commander, but the command effect is weak. The effect values are undecided. They do not automatically receive the same class or campaign role as a formal hero commander.
플레이어는 분대 말에 목표 지점을 지시하고, 분대 말은 세계 시간이 흐르: The player gives a squad token a destination, and the squad token moves along a route to that point as world time passes. Movement speed and distance values are not locked in this document. Surface territory and subway lines are separate movement layers, and layer transitions happen only at designated transfer or entry nodes.
공격·요격 개시 불가. 피격 시 준비도 불이익: Cannot initiate attacks or interceptions. Readiness penalty when attacked
지형·정찰·정보 상태를 비교한 결정론 규칙으로 탐지·요격: Detects and intercepts using deterministic rules that compare terrain, reconnaissance, and intelligence status
회복·보급·모집 가능 여부는 거점 계약을 따른다: Whether recovery, supply, and recruitment are possible follows the stronghold contract
이동을 끝내고 현장 정비: Ends movement and performs field maintenance
거점보다 제한된 회복·정비. 공격 개시 불가: More limited recovery and maintenance than at a stronghold. Cannot initiate attacks
적 분대나 거점의 통제권에 진입하면 이동이 멈춘다. 다음 명령은 후퇴·공: Movement stops when a squad enters the control zone of an enemy squad or stronghold. The next order is one of retreat, attack, or an authorized detour. When a movement order is received, the stance, terrain, right of passage, blockade, layer, and control along the entire route are checked. An illegal route is not automatically traveled partway; the entire order is rejected.
공격·요격·증원·분리·합류·태세 변경은 서로 다른 명령이다. 전투가 열리: Attack, interception, reinforcement, splitting, merging, and stance change are separate orders. When combat opens, the participants, commanders, stances, layer, and reinforcement candidates are finalized and passed to a closed combat context. The combat result is recorded in the ledger only once.
최대 10인 공유 월드 시간: Shared World Time for Up to 10 Players
온라인 세션은 호스트를 포함해 최대 10명의 플레이어가 참가하도록 설계한: Online sessions are designed to allow up to 10 players, including the host. The number 10 is the cap on concurrent players, not a cap on heroes, squads, or factions. This documentation work does not change the backend's current limit values.
플레이어는 소유 분대에 언제든 명령을 내린다. 계획 단계와 해결 단계를: Players can give orders to their own squads at any time. There is no separation into planning and resolution phases.
비플레이어 팩션은 시스템 AI가 같은 명령 계약으로 명령한다. AI 전용: Non-player factions are commanded by the system AI through the same order contract. There is no AI-only teleportation, free movement, or hidden orders.
공유 월드의 캠페인 시간에는 일시정지와 감속·배속이 없다. 마지막 플레이: Campaign time in a shared world has no pause, slow-down, or fast-forward. The rule that stops the world when the last player leaves remains unchanged.
Accepted orders are applied in the next simulation step in deterministic acceptance order.
세계 시간은 흐르는 동안 계속 나아간다. 주간 긴장·위기·음모·계승 임계: World time keeps advancing while it flows. Weekly tension, crisis, conspiracy, and succession thresholds are judged by this time.
전투가 열리면 전투 중인 분대만 결과가 정산될 때까지 새 이동 명령을 받: When combat opens, only the squads in combat do not receive new movement orders until the result is settled. Other squads and players continue to move.
같은 구간·거점에서 충돌하면 태세, 지형, 통제권, 정찰·매복·정보 상태: When a conflict occurs in the same segment or stronghold, stance, terrain, control, and reconnaissance, ambush, and intelligence status are compared. The same input yields the same result.
플레이어 연결이 끊겨도 명령 원장은 유지한다. 재접속한 플레이어는 수락된: Even if a player's connection drops, the order ledger is retained. A reconnecting player receives the accepted orders and result receipts again. Whether the AI acts on a player's behalf while no orders are given is not decided in this document.
이동·정지·경로 변경·태세·분리·합류·지휘관 교체와 AI 대행은 명령 I: Movement, stopping, route changes, stance changes, splitting, merging, commander replacement, and AI proxy actions carry an order ID, world time, acceptance order, applied simulation step, actor, target squad, cause, rule version, and before-and-after check values. Replaying the same starting state and the same order ledger must produce the same squad positions, compositions, encounters, and combat participants.
백엔드 코디네이터는 명령 내용을 해석하지 않는다. 참가자 인증, 최대 인: The backend coordinator does not interpret the content of orders. It handles only participant authentication, maximum headcount, session/room connections, and JSON relay. The authoritative game server validates, sorts, and resolves orders according to the rule version and delivers receipts to all participants.
캠페인 시점과 권한 전이의 설계 청사진은 캠페인 POV와 권한이다. 그: The design blueprint for the campaign viewpoint and authority transitions is Campaign POV and Authority. That diagram is not an implemented UI.
전략맵에는 소유 분대 목록, 영웅 지휘관, 병졸 수, 태세, 이동 목표와: The strategic map displays the list of owned squads, hero commanders, rank-and-file counts, stances, movement destinations and remaining routes, and current layer and position.
분대 선택 뒤 이동·태세·분리·합류·지휘관 교체를 각각 독립 행동으로 연: After a squad is selected, movement, stance change, splitting, merging, and commander replacement each open as independent actions.

영웅 분리 규칙을 개별 영웅의 이동·공격·회피 연속 입력이나 초인적 직접: The hero separation rule is not to be changed into continuous input of an individual hero's movement, attack, and dodge, or into superhuman direct actions.

Surrendered, routed, wounded, or surviving characters are not all automatically turned into prisoners.
No new capture probabilities, holding capacities, or figures are created.
부대 명령은 선택한 영웅 액터 또는 병사 분대와 이동·공격 대상·사격·매: A unit order specifies the selected hero actor or soldier squad together with one of the following: move, attack target, fire, or ambush.

선택하지 않은 상태에서 명령을 확정하는 일: Confirming a command without a selection having been made.

`LegalFallback` 실패를 질서 있는 명령 철수로 처리하는 일: Treating a `LegalFallback` failure as an orderly command withdrawal.

명령 철수, 사기 패주, 수락된 항복과 포획을 같은 상태로 처리하는 일: Handling command withdrawal, morale rout, accepted surrender, and capture as the same state.
항복자·패주자·부상자·생존자를 자동 포획하는 일: Automatically capturing surrendered, routed, wounded, or surviving units.

UI 표현으로 Core 판정을 대신하는 일: Substituting UI presentation for Core adjudication.
전투 리셋으로 캠페인 진행이나 이미 반영한 결과를 되돌리는 일: Using a battle reset to roll back campaign progress or results that have already been applied.
결과 반영을 강제 귀환으로 처리하는 일: Treating the application of a result as a forced return.
동일 입력이 다른 결과를 내는 일: Having identical inputs produce different results.
새 실시간 이동 공식을 발명하는 일: Inventing a new real-time movement formula.
근접 교전 중인 부대에 새 명령을 받는 일: Accepting a new command for a unit that is engaged in melee.
자동 전투와 수동 전투에 서로 다른 판정 규칙을 쓰는 일: Using different adjudication rules for auto-battle and manual battle.
공격 판정 표나 임계 수치를 이 문서에서 정하는 일: Setting attack adjudication tables or threshold values in this document.

A battle reset returns only the currently closed battle session to its starting state, before settlement.
It is not used as a means of undoing campaign progress or results that have already been applied.
Visual movement in the UI is presented to follow the Core's logical state.
화면에서만 부대를 움직여 Core의 이동 판정이나 수락된 명령을 대신하지: Units are not moved on screen alone to replace the Core's movement resolution or accepted orders.
Reinforcements enter as a separate force according to the reinforcement conditions fixed at the start of the battle.
Reinforcements are not changed by re-querying the outer campaign state in the middle of a battle.
현재 목표에는 실시간 이동 틱, 공격 쿨다운, 전투 시간 상한이나 카드: The current objective does not newly set any real-time movement ticks, attack cooldowns, battle time limits, or card recharge values.

인물의 유파 전수는 그 부대가 확정된 부대 명령을 수행하는 방식으로만 전: A character's school transmission shows up in battle only as the way that unit carries out a confirmed unit order.
유파가 있는 영웅도 같은 부대 명령을 받으며, 유파 기법은 새 명령 종류: A hero with a school receives the same unit orders, and school techniques do not create new order types, order queues, cards, or ability resources.
The variable capacity of a soldier squad does not refer to the capacity of school transmission personnel.
기법은 일반 승리·패배, 명령 철수, 사기 패주, 수락된 항복의 종료 판: Techniques do not override the end-of-battle resolution of a normal victory or defeat, an ordered withdrawal, a morale rout, or an accepted surrender.
The battle result is decided by each individual soldier's attack resolution.
판정에는 공격자의 무기, 방어자의 방어구, 두 사람의 전투 기술 차이,: The resolution includes the attacker's weapon, the defender's armor, the difference in the two combatants' combat skills, and their physical condition and mood.
기본 개인 능력·기술·공격 3d6·능동 방어·DR·피해 유형·부상 기준을: Starting from the basic individual abilities, skills, 3d6 attack, active defense, DR, damage types, and wound criteria, an original Seoul: Nationwide formula is designed across all three scopes: individual hit, defense, damage, and wounds; command, supply, and battlefield-situation modifiers; and unit-aggregate resolution (owner confirmed). 플레이어는 교전 전에 편성·장비·지휘관과 교전 여부를 정하고 근접 교전에: Before engagement, the player decides the formation, equipment, commander, and whether to engage, and a unit that has entered melee engagement receives no orders until that engagement ends. 참가자, 전장, 목표, 보급, 합법 퇴로, 증원 조건, 전투 시드와 규칙: Participants, battlefield, objective, supply, legal fallback, reinforcement conditions, battle seed, and rule and content versions are fixed as the immutable context.
실제 참가 영웅은 별도 전술 액터로 두고 일반 병력은 해당 지휘관·국가·: Heroes who actually take part are placed as separate tactical actors, and regular troops are organized into squads matching the variable capacity of the relevant commander, state, and settlement, after which pre-battle placement and formation are decided.
자동 전투와 수동 전투 가운데 하나를 고른다. 두 방식은 같은 판정 규칙: Choose either automatic or manual battle. Both modes use the same resolution rules.
수동 전투에서는 교전 전인 영웅 액터나 병사 분대를 선택한 경우에만 이동: In manual battle, move, attack-target, fire, and ambush orders are opened only when a hero actor or soldier squad that is not yet engaged has been selected, and retreat is opened as an order for the entire battle.
Path, target, and arrival-formation previews do not change state.
확정 때 같은 컨텍스트로 다시 검사하고, 새 지시로 교전 전 부대의 현재: On confirmation, the order is validated again against the same context, and the new instruction replaces the pre-engagement unit's current instruction while the acceptance order is recorded.
전장 생성, 병사별 공격 판정, 피해, 사기와 증원을 시드와 수락된 명령: Battlefield generation, per-soldier attack resolution, damage, morale, and reinforcements proceed from the seed and the accepted-order record.
종료 원인을 일반 승리·패배, 명령 철수, 사기 패주, 수락된 항복 가운: The cause of ending is classified as one of a normal victory or defeat, an ordered withdrawal, a morale rout, or an accepted surrender.
Whether someone is captured is recorded separately from the end state, in each character's custody result.
전투 사실과 불변 `ResultId`를 한 번 발행하고 캠페인이 정확히: The battle facts and an immutable `ResultId` are issued once, and the campaign settles them exactly once.
정산 뒤 원정을 계속하거나 귀환·정착·정복·방랑·교역 가운데 다음 결말을: After settlement, continue the expedition or choose the next outcome from return, settlement, conquest, wandering, or trade.
개별 영웅의 이동·공격·회피 연계나 콤보를 직접 조작하는 일: Directly controlling individual heroes' movement, attack, and evasion chains or combos
수락된 명령과 결과 영수증을 원장 순서대로 보여 준다. 전투 중인 분대에: Shows accepted commands and result receipts in ledger order. Move-command input is blocked for squads that are in combat.

Current character IDs, equipment, supplies, and labor reservations are kept and are changed only in an actual reorganization event.
