There is one world time. This domain describes the relationship among aggregated and individualized residents, labor reservations, the actual fulfillment of wages and rations, and unit strength. It distinguishes confirmed relationships from figures and policies that have not yet been chosen.
**본체 인물과 NPC.** 일거리·교육·치료·구매를 요청하고 자기 일정: **Principal characters and NPCs.** They request jobs, education, treatment, and purchases, and act according to their own schedules and conditions for carrying things out. Receiving an order does not automatically erase their desires, goals, or existing schedules.
**집계 주민과 개인화된 주민.** 개인화는 집계에 있던 같은 사람을 빼: **Aggregated residents and individualized residents.** Individualization means taking the same person who was in the aggregate out and representing them separately; it is not the creation of a person. From the aggregate stage, every member has a distinct permanent internal ID, and individualization and later return carry that ID over unchanged. A name is an optional search clue and not the identity that distinguishes people with the same name; the stable ID of the selected record establishes identity.
**시설·운송·부대·치료의 담당자.** 각 역할의 시간과 자원을 예약하고: **Personnel in charge of facilities, transport, units, and treatment.** They reserve the time and resources of each role and record the results. An institution's appointment authority, authority to dispose of goods, authority to assign civilian labor, and military command authority do not substitute for one another.
**국가 기관.** 나라별 임금·배급 제도는 유지한다. 공통으로 읽는 것: **State institutions.** Each country's wage and ration system is maintained. What is read in common is the actual payment, arrival, and consumption results. A particular country's past rosters or the setting-based location of an institution alone do not create current residents' eligibility to receive.
**지휘관과 분대장.** 본체가 전투 지휘관이면 유효한 지휘 범위에 배속: **Commanders and squad leaders.** If the principal character is a combat commander, they can coordinate all squads assigned within their valid command scope. Even if there is a separate squad leader, higher authority is not blocked, and no control authority arises over visible enemy forces, independent forces, or allied forces outside the scope.

플레이어는 집계의 누구를 개인화할지, 어떤 역할을 언제 요청할지, 역할이: The player decides which members of a tally to individualize, which roles to request and when, whether to return survivors whose roles have ended to the tally, and which needs to meet through rations and purchases. Assigning another person's labor requires the authority appropriate to that action, plus the other party's acceptance and any institutional procedure. Looking someone up or searching by name does not by itself grant assignment authority. Who initiates a specific individualization or return, each state's registry enrollment procedure, and the order for reconciling ration fulfillment against purchase needs are all undecided.
자격은 대상 존재·판본, 생존과 수행 가능성, 권한, 실제 장소·연락 경: Eligibility is checked separately for target existence and version, survival and ability to perform, authority, actual location and contact route, resources and exclusive reservations, and the other party's consent and institutional procedure. Lacking a skill or equipment, being in transit, and being injured are distinct states. Injury is not a blanket marker that bans every action; it changes the performance conditions of the role in question. Viewing a registry is not creating a unit. A muster requires checks for personnel acceptance, equipment, supplies, a commander, and reservations, and the details of recruitment consent and who provides equipment have not yet been decided.
**집계와 개인은 한 번만 센다.** 인구 사건이 없는 N명 집계에서 한: **Tallies and individuals are counted only once.** When one person is individualized from a tally of N people with no population events, the tally becomes N−1 and the individual is 1, so the sum remains N. That person is removed from the tally's available labor. A return converts the same ID back into the tally and releases the individual representation, so no new person is added. A duplicate input that tries to add the individual back into the tally is rejected, and the last valid tally and individual state is kept. Birth, death, migration, and capture are population and custody events separate from representation changes. The total-population conservation example holds only when no such events occur.
**한 사람의 역할은 겹치지 않는다.** 같은 사람의 예약은 시작을 포함: **One person's roles do not overlap.** The reservations of the same person occupy the half-open interval [start, end), which includes the start and excludes the end. Two reservations overlap when `A.sijak < B.jongnyo-igo B.sijak < A.jongnyo` (that is, A.start < B.end and B.start < A.end), and roles that overlap by a positive amount of time are not assigned. If they merely touch at a boundary, as in `A.jongnyo = B.sijak` (A.end = B.start), the end of the earlier role and the start of the next role can switch at the same moment. The verdict is the same even if the comparison or insertion order changes, and touching one reservation is never a reason to ignore an actual overlap with another. Simultaneous labor by different people does not violate this per-person exclusivity condition, and the separate capacity of facilities and equipment is checked separately. Input whose start and end are equal, or whose start is later than its end, is treated as not a valid time interval before the overlap check. This does not allow zero-hour roles or set any separate duration policy. Releasing the existing reservation and acquiring the new one in a schedule change are recorded as a single transition.
**필수 수요와 실제 이행은 다르다.** 하루 수요에서 필수 소비·계약·: **Essential demand and actual fulfillment are different.** From daily demand, essential consumption, contracts, and supplies are reserved first, and approved orders are processed within the bottlenecks of labor, inputs, power, facilities, and storage. Ration reservation, actual issuance, arrival, and consumption are distinct states. A ration share is not double-counted as purchase demand. The settlement order is undecided between first reconciling ration fulfillment to derive the remaining purchase need, and first recording the purchase request and then offsetting it by the rations actually issued; either way, the same need and fulfillment must not be counted twice. The same labor loss caused by a shortage is applied only once across life and economy, while satisfaction, mood, loyalty, and relationships are retained separately. The labor reduction coefficient to apply and the shortage resolution procedure are undecided.
**정원은 세 방향을 따른다.** 지휘관 개인 능력·국가 수준·정착지 수: **Unit capacity follows three dimensions.** Capacity varies with the commander's personal ability, the state's level, and the settlement's level, and no single cap is applied to all units. The old fixed 20 has been replaced. Which abilities and levels count, and how they are calculated, is not yet defined. Reducing capacity does not delete excess personnel, and heroes are counted separately from rank-and-file troops. Units must be reorganized while preserving people and equipment, but the reorganization cost and detailed procedure are undecided.
전·행동·후: 소집과 치료: Before, Action, After: Muster and Treatment
다음의 500명·5명·3명은 관계를 설명하는 예시이지 정원·생성률·최소: The following figures of 500, 5, and 3 are examples illustrating relationships, not capacity, creation rates, or minimum sizes. Birth, death, migration, and capture are assumed not to occur.
**전.** 집계 500, 개인 0이다. 개인화할 다섯은 집계 단계부터: **Before.** The tally is 500 and individuals are 0. The five people to be individualized each have a distinct permanent ID from the tally stage onward, and individualization neither creates nor changes those IDs. The day's essential demand is secured first, and actual receipt and consumption are confirmed separately.
**행동.** 다섯을 개인화하면 집계 495, 개인 5다. 그 다섯 중: **Action.** Individualizing the five makes the tally 495 and individuals 5. Three of those five can be reserved for unit roles at the same time. Each person must have no reservation overlapping an existing role. The roles of the other two are not determined by this example. If the five people's essential shares are already reserved, they are not reserved again as additional ration reservations. Issuance, arrival, and consumption are recorded in sequence, and the same shares are not re-counted as purchase demand. If one of the three mustered people is injured, the same ID and history are kept, and the reservation is switched between the unit and treatment roles. After treatment, the person meets the return eligibility and goes back into the tally.
**후.** 집계 496, 개인 4, 총 500이다. 개인 네 명 중 둘: **After.** The tally is 496, individuals are 4, and the total is 500. Of the four individuals, two are remaining unit members and two are individuals who were not mustered. The one who returned is in the tally and is not counted again among the individuals. The past unit and treatment labor history and consumption are not erased by the return. Receiving the same event again does not increase population, labor, or supplies.
**별도 복귀 예제.** 치료 사례와 별개로, 집계 495·개인 5에서: **Separate return example.** Apart from the treatment case, if all three mustered from a tally of 495 and 5 individuals return, the tally is 498 and individuals are 2. The number of returnees in the two examples rests on different assumptions.
실패·중단·사망 뒤에 남는 것: What Remains After Failure, Interruption, and Death
같은 사람의 겹치는 둘째 역할은 거절하고 첫 역할과 신원을 유지한다. 기: A second role that overlaps for the same person is rejected, and the first role and the person's identity are kept. Against an existing [10,20), [12,18) overlaps for a positive duration and is rejected, while [20,25) only touches at the boundary and is allowed. Given existing [10,20) and [25,35), a request for [20,30) touches the first reservation but overlaps the second during [25,30), so it is rejected. These numbers are examples showing the approved boundary semantics, not rules for duration, cost, or priority.
권한·장소·자원이 부족하거나 상대가 수락하지 않으면 해당 요청의 거절·보: When authority, location, or resources are insufficient, or the other party does not accept, the request's rejection, deferral, and negotiation are distinguished. Valid existing records are not erased arbitrarily.
승인 뒤 사망·해임·점령·연락 두절 또는 작업 취소가 발생하면 남은 작업: If death, dismissal, occupation, loss of contact, or cancellation of the work occurs after approval, the performance conditions of the remaining work are checked again. Supplies already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed. Remaining reservations and unused resources are released or preserved according to the contract in question. A dead person's reservation is not revived by a return. Death is a separate population event, and there is no guarantee that the population equals its pre-action value.
건설 단계에서 이미 사용한 재료는 중단만으로 자동 환급하지 않는다. 완성: Materials already used in the construction stage are not automatically refunded merely because work stops. Completed progress, unused materials, material ownership, and labor reservations are kept separate. The timing is undecided between acquiring the storage reservation on entering the output stage and securing it at an earlier stage. Whichever is chosen, completed earlier stages are not erased on the grounds of insufficient storage.
같은 사건 ID 재전송은 새 결과를 만들지 않는다. 판본 충돌·손상 저장: Resending the same event ID does not create a new result. A version conflict or corrupted save is an explicit error. Saving and loading restore the current stage at a consistent boundary and are not a death or cancellation within the world.
정보·시간·권한의 경계: Boundaries of Information, Time, and Authority
이름은 선택적 검색 단서이고 안정된 ID가 선택된 인물의 신원을 해결한다: A name is an optional search clue, and a stable ID resolves the identity of the selected person. People with the same name are not merged into one person. Every tally member has a distinct permanent internal ID from the tally stage onward, and individualization and return continue using the same ID. This representation approval does not determine the ID issuance algorithm, the storage schema, return eligibility, or institutional authority. A past identity registration is also not authoritative for current location, position, rights, or cast figures. An unrecorded location is distinguished from currently absent, and a person is not marked as a local worker without grounds.
도착 검증 시각이 소비 마감 이하인 화물만 그 마감 재고에 포함한다. 같: Only cargo whose arrival verification time is at or before the consumption cutoff is included in that cutoff's inventory. At the same time, arrival verification is processed first. Cargo that arrives after the cutoff is excluded only from that cutoff and does not remain forever in transit after it actually arrives. Arrival records are read at the subsequent boundaries of reservation, production, and consumption. The daily cutoff is not a turn that stops movement in the world.
Any unit that actually arrives at a battle in progress can take part as reinforcements. A battle that has already ended receives no new arrivals. Arrival cycles, placement, transfer of command, and capacity figures are separately undecided. Higher-level orders reach the main body's squad leader immediately as a system signal, but the main body chooses to follow, partially comply, or act independently. Purpose, feasibility, actual action, contribution, losses, and the like are recorded in the commander's memory and in later assignment decisions, distinguishing compliance from results. No fixed insubordination penalty has been set. Immediate battle orders are not instantaneous processing like strategic movement or remote contact. Battles have no pause, speed control, or command queue.
전쟁에는 유효하게 등록된 정당한 명분과 그 명분에 이름으로 지정된 적격: A war requires a validly registered just cause and an eligible beneficiary designated by name in that cause. A war is not created from an invalid cause. While a war is in progress, the cause's validity and the designated beneficiary's eligibility are rechecked before the war-score endpoint, and if either has disappeared, the corresponding invalidity rule is handled before forced termination at the endpoint is applied. −100 to +100 is the war score, not the range of a territorial objective. If the endpoint is reached while the validity of the cause and the designated beneficiary is maintained, the war is forcibly terminated with that cause's victory or defeat effects, and no rights outside the objective are additionally acquired by force. Below an absolute value of 100, item-by-item negotiation is allowed with valid authority, price version, and fulfillment conditions. Only the signing and settlement of unregistered valuation items are blocked. Labor reservations do not change that boundary.
**D01 인물·능력:** 영구 신원과 능력. D04는 집계 단계부터 부: **D01 Characters and Abilities:** Permanent identity and abilities. D04 refers to the unique ID assigned from the tally stage onward and does not create a new person through representation changes. The specific issuance algorithm and storage schema are separately undecided.
**D02 생활·건강:** 충족·기분·충성·건강, 같은 부족 노동 손실의: **D02 Life and Health:** Satisfaction, mood, loyalty, and health, and the single application of the same shortage-related labor loss. No health coefficient is invented from wage or ration fulfillment.
**D03 행동·일정:** 권한·전달·수락·보류·교섭과 예약 전환. 노동: **D03 Actions and Schedules:** Authority, delivery, acceptance, deferral, negotiation, and reservation transitions. Labor feasibility and command authority are separate.
**D05 경제·생산:** 병목·재료 소비·단계 진척·보관. D04의 노: **D05 Economy and Production:** Bottlenecks, material consumption, stage progress, and storage. D04's labor reservations and the details of mapping construction stages are undecided.
**D06 이동·화물:** 실제 이동·도착 및 마감별 재고 자격. 조회·: **D06 Movement and Cargo:** Actual movement, arrival, and per-cutoff inventory eligibility. Lookup and muster requests are not arrivals.
**D09·D10 기관·권리:** 국가별 절차와 직위·처분권. 기관 소재: **D09·D10 Institutions and Rights:** State-specific procedures and positions and powers of disposal. An institution's location is not a ration eligibility formula.
**D15 Combat:** Command of assigned squads, temporary squad leaders, and actual reinforcement and reorganization. A capacity reduction is not the deletion of characters.
**D18 시간·사건·저장:** 하나의 세계 시계, 수락 순서·원인 사건: **D18 Time, Events, and Saves:** A single world clock, acceptance order and causal events, save boundaries, and prevention of duplicate application.
두 원작의 검증된 비교: Verified Comparison of the Two Source Works
**자격·입력 부족.** 전: 같은 단계에 기존 진척·자재가 있으나 필요: **Insufficient qualification or input.** Before: The same step has existing progress and materials, but the required qualification or input is missing. Action: The progress request is checked. After: The step does not advance. Existing progress and unused materials remain, and no new consumption or output is created. Unused materials that remain are not called a refund.
【승인】 필수 소비·계약·보급 수요를 먼저 예약하고 승인된 주문만 인력·: 【Approved】 Required consumption, contract, and supply demand is reserved first, and only approved orders are processed within the limits of labor, inputs, power, facilities, and storage. A target stock level can serve as demand information, but automatic production unrelated to a material shortage, or duplicate processing of the same consumption, is not permitted.
전: 여러 주문이 입력과 작업 능력을 필요로 하며 일부 주문은 이미 부분: Before: Several orders need inputs and work capacity, and some orders are already partially complete. Action: When an authority adjusts priorities, the existing reservations are released and made anew. After: Existing partially completed work and consumed amounts are preserved. Changing a reservation is not an action that removes finished goods or reruns production from the beginning. Per-item production rates, the economic period, bottleneck formulas, rounding, and tie-break allocation are undecided.
건설 일 예약과 주문의 수요 수량을 혼동하지 않는다. 생산 주문이나 화물: Do not confuse a construction work reservation with the demand quantity of an order. Cancelling a production order or a cargo route, or the death of someone tied to one, does not by itself release other construction work reservations. However, a policy that every field of that order or cargo is permanently immutable has not been approved. An actual cancellation or death checks the world facts and handles the remaining resources according to the applicable contract.
【승인】 검증된 도착 시각이 소비 마감 이하이면 해당 마감의 가용 재고에: 【Approved】 If the verified arrival time is at or before the consumption cutoff, the cargo is included in the available stock for that cutoff. At the same world time, processing runs in the order of arrival verification, then reservation, production, and consumption, and causality follows acceptance order and causing event. The same arrival ID is never applied twice. Materials in transit are neither consumed nor counted at the same time as available stock at both origin and destination.
전: 도착지에 부족 수요가 있고 화물이 이동 중이다. 행동: 실제 도착과: Before: The destination has a shortage demand and cargo is in transit. Action: The actual arrival and quantity are verified and compared with the common daily cutoff. After: An arrival at exactly the cutoff time is also included. Materials that actually arrive after the cutoff are excluded from **that cutoff**, but they do not remain in transit forever. The actual arrival state is reflected, and which later consumption it is used for is decided by the next applicable common daily cutoff and reservation contract.
【Approved】 The selected scope of GP-06 is fixed to the following seven directions. Splitting cargo retires the parent cargo and creates two child cargoes that carry on the parent's history and ownership. Receipt does not become available stock until the recipient's confirming signature. On a reservation version conflict, the existing reservation is kept, the conflict reason and current version are reported, and the requester is asked to re-propose with an explicit new intent; it is not placed in an automatic queue. The consumption cutoff is a common daily phase, not a per-station option. If a blockade and an arrival are independently proposed at the same time, they are adjudicated in input receipt order. Cargo that fails receipt verification is quarantined locally and not automatically refunded, and the destination reservation whose proof is pending is kept. Cargo not delivered by the cutoff also keeps its in-transit, unfulfilled status and destination reservation, and does not become available or consumable stock.
이 선택은 GP-06 전체 완료가 아니다. 하루의 간격 단위와 위상 값,: This selection does not mean GP-06 is fully complete. The day's interval unit and phase values, the calendar origin and clock details, the distribution method, persistent storage, the receipt identifier and signature authentication rules, loss and shortage coefficients, the full readiness of the source originals, and actual in-game behavior are still undecided.
6. 건설 일 예약의 해제 제안: 6. Proposals for Releasing Construction Work Reservations
다음은 모두 【제안】이다. 세계 사실과 권한 검사는 필수 전제이며 요청자: All of the following are 【Proposals】. Checking world facts and authority is a required precondition, and neither a label attached by the requester nor a matching stored reference alone confirms death or non-use.
**사용 전 취소.** 전: 특정 인물에게 특정 미수행 건설 일이 예약되: **Cancellation before use.** Before: A specific unperformed construction task is reserved for a specific person, and the task's inputs have not yet been used. Action: An authorized cancellation request checks the target and whether the inputs have actually been used. Proposal A: Only the unused task reservation is released, and materials, ownership, consumed amounts, and completed progress are preserved. If inputs have already been used, this is treated as a suspension of progress rather than an unused cancellation. Proposal B: The cancellation request is left in a review state, and an authority confirms the release of the reservation. Neither option automatically generates reassignment, new work, or a refund.
**담당자 사망.** 전: 일부 완료된 건설의 남은 일이 특정 인물에게: **Death of the assignee.** Before: The remaining work of a partially completed construction is reserved for a specific person. Action: The current fact of death and the relevant reservation are rechecked. Proposal A: After death is confirmed, the reservation for the remaining work is released. Proposal B: The remaining work is put on temporary hold, and the reservation is cleaned up together with a reassignment decision. Completed progress, consumed amounts, unused materials, and their ownership are preserved under both alternatives. D05 does not automatically generate a successor or a new performer. If the death is unconfirmed or points to a different reservation or person, no release result is produced and the case is left in a state requiring confirmation.
저장된 참조로 같은 인물·예약을 구별하는 기술 표현은 가능하지만 실제 투: A technical expression that distinguishes the same person and reservation by a stored reference is possible, but there is not yet a producer for actual deployment, death, and authority checks, nor a link to D04 labor reservations. Therefore this proposal must not be read as complete implementation or as an approved world policy.
플레이어는 단계 진행/중단 여부, 완료 진척, 이미 사용한 입력, 미사용: The player must be able to see whether a step is advancing or suspended, completed progress, inputs already used, the location and owner of unused materials, the distinction between work reservations and demand reservations, partial order completion, the verified arrival time, and whether it falls within the cutoff. This is information needed for judgment; the screen layout, access rights, and means of obtaining information are not yet designed. Unverified arrivals or deaths are not displayed as confirmed information.
자격·권한·필수 입력 부족이면 해당 행동을 실행하지 않고 이유와 남은 상: If qualification, authority, or a required input is lacking, the action is not executed, and the reason and the remaining state are distinguished. In doing so, a state where the institution or approving party is not yet determined, a state where the necessary evidence could not be accessed or fact-checking is insufficient, and a state where the action was actually found to be prohibited are not shown as the same. How hidden facts are accessed or disclosed is undecided. A saved-version conflict or corruption is an explicit error and is not recovered by automatic renumbering, migration, or mixing rules. Resending the same event creates no new result, and an already applied result ID is not reapplied. The preservation rules for an actual cancellation, death, or suspension and the rejection of a technical request are separate judgments. Quitting or loading is not a death or cancellation event in the world.
**수리 중단:** 가정으로 이미 자재 4개를 쓰고 8개가 현장에 남아: **Repair suspension:** Suppose 4 materials have already been used and 8 remain on site. Even if the step is suspended, the 4 do not come back, and the 8 and the completed progress are preserved. Using 4 materials does not mean progress of 4. The owner of the materials and the on-site custodian may differ.
**주문 우선순위 변경:** 보급 주문이 일부 완료된 뒤 계약 주문의 우: **Order priority change:** After a supply order is partially complete, the priority of a contract order is changed. The earlier reservations are released and the new reservations are checked, but the partially completed supply goods and the inputs already used are not deducted again. Without bottleneck capacity, production does not take place from the new priority alone.
**마감 경계:** 가정으로 도착 전 가용 물자 13개, 이동 중 해당: **Cutoff boundary:** Suppose there are 13 available materials before arrival and 9 in the cargo in transit. If the 9 arrive and are verified at the same time as the cutoff, 22 are available before consumption and that cargo is no longer in transit. If they arrive just after the cutoff, only 13 are usable for that cutoff, but the 9 that actually arrived are not left permanently in transit.
**취소·사망 비교:** 제안 A에서 미사용 건설 일 취소는 그 예약만: **Cancellation and death compared:** Under Proposal A, cancelling an unused construction task releases only that reservation. Even if cumulative consumption exists in other work, it does not equal whether this task was unused. If a different assignee at the same site has died, the target reservation is not released. Even if that assignee's death is confirmed, materials already used and completed progress are preserved, and reassignment is separate.
D05가 받는 것과 대신 결정하지 않는 것: What D05 Receives and What It Does Not Decide for Others
현재 인물·능력. 수행 자격·동의가 있다는 뜻으로 과거 명부를 쓰지 않는: Current characters and abilities. Past rosters are not used to imply qualification or consent to perform.

실제 이동과 도착 검증. D05는 검증 도착분의 마감 포함을 결정한다: Actual movement and arrival verification. D05 decides whether verified arrivals are included in the cutoff.
세계 사망과 후계 절차. D05는 그 사실에 따라 자신의 예약을 재검사한: World death and succession procedures. D05 rechecks its own reservations according to those facts.
법적 소유·이전·인도 권리. 예약 해제만으로 소유를 바꾸지 않는다: Legal ownership, transfer, and delivery rights. Releasing a reservation alone does not change ownership.

플레이어는 생존한 개막 인물 가운데 한 사람을 본체로 선택하고 한 본체로: The player selects one of the surviving opening characters as their main body and continues the campaign with that single body. Screen transitions do not rewind time or duplicate the main body at a remote location.
NPC도 플레이어와 같은 이동·관측·명령 계약을 쓴다. NPC라는 이유로: NPCs use the same movement, observation, and command contracts as the player. Being an NPC does not allow teleporting or knowing current facts without information.
부대는 실제 위치와 경로를 따라 이동한다. 지도, 지휘관, 분대, 운송: Units move along actual positions and routes. The map, commanders, squads, transport means, cargo, the cargo's owner and custodian, and the evaluating party who judges reports are the actors of this domain.
이름은 사람이 기록을 찾는 검색 수단이다. 검색 결과에서 선택된 사람·부: A name is a search tool for people to find records. The identity of a person, unit, cargo, or event selected from search results resolves to a permanent stable identifier. The same name does not mean the same entity, and a stable identifier does not forbid searching by name.
세계 시간은 하나다. 이동·화물·관측 사건은 같은 세계의 진행을 공유한다: There is one world time. Movement, cargo, and observation events share the progression of the same world.
플레이어는 경로 후보를 골라 실제 이동을 시도하고, 멀리 있는 대상에게: The player picks route candidates and attempts actual movement, sends strategic commands to distant targets, receives sourced reports and judges them, and makes arrived cargo usable according to verified receipt records. Which routes are lawful and passable, and who records a blockage and in what state, have not yet been decided. If a unit has actually arrived at an ongoing battle, that unit's participation is handled. If the main body is a battle commander, valid commands and immediate signals can be sent only to squads that are within the command range registered in that battle session and are also on that session's assigned squad list. Enemy forces, unassigned independent or allied forces, allied forces outside the command range, and other main bodies or other sites are not command targets.
전투 신호는 전략 원격 명령과 다르다. 전투에는 일시정지, 속도 조절,: Battle signals differ from strategic remote commands. Battles have no pause, speed control, or command queue. The main body's squad leader may follow an immediate command, follow it only in part, or act autonomously, and the evaluating party remembers who sent the command and the result identification. The coefficients of this evaluation have not yet been decided.
부대는 출발 위치에 실제로 있어야 하고 이동은 실제 거리, 수단, 짐,: A unit must actually be at its departure location, and movement takes actual distance, means, load, fatigue, and route status as inputs. Changing the strategic screen cannot substitute for movement. However, route legality, impassability determination, preservation of blockage status, storage of remaining segments, information freshness, and exact settlement of failed movement are the unresolved scope of GP-02. Map lines, station markers, and the mere existence of a known track do not create adjacency or passage permission. Only physical adjacency to the actual next station, whose source, edition, and verification status have been confirmed, can become a route candidate. An express train skipping intermediate stations is not a movement edge, and service line, physical connection, and current passage status are distinguished. Unconfirmed connections are not displayed or used for movement. The current passability of a route candidate and the right of passage are checked separately. The GP-02 alternatives are limited to the following for route candidates meeting these conditions: checking the entire route before departure and rejecting it; approving only the known segments and stopping at the blocked point; or approving segment by segment and then re-proposing a detour.
실제 연락 경로가 있고 대상이 명령을 수신하고 수락해야 실행된다. 어느: A command is executed only if there is an actual communication channel and the target receives and accepts it. If any one of these is missing, the command remains unexecuted. An immediate signal sent to a battle squad leader is separate from this procedure and does not make strategic movement instantaneous.
평가 주체가 직접 보거나 출처 있는 보고를 받았을 때 그 주체의 지식과: When the evaluating party sees something directly or receives a sourced report, that party's knowledge and confirmation time are updated. A report is not itself the current fact of the world. An old report does not guarantee current position, and the absence of a report is not evidence that the region is empty or safe. The same fixed resource is not granted repeatedly by the same exploration, and merely reading a record does not duplicate proficiency.
법적 소유와 물리적 보관은 별개다. 소유권이 옮겨도 적 점유 창고의 물자: Legal ownership and physical custody are separate. Even if ownership transfers, supplies in an enemy-held warehouse do not teleport into the inventory. Cargo in transit retains its asset identity and split origin, cannot be used before arrival, and is not counted simultaneously as available stock at both the origin and the destination. Institutional assets remain with the institution.
검증된 도착 시각이 소비 마감 시각과 같거나 앞서면 그 도착분은 그 마감: If the verified arrival time is equal to or earlier than the consumption cutoff time, that arrived cargo is included in the available quantity of that cutoff. At the same time, arrival is verified first, followed by reservation, production, and consumption. This is an approved economic and logistics rule that D05, D06, D13, and D18 consume together. Cargo that arrives after the cutoff is excluded **from that cutoff only**. Cargo is not permanently fixed as in transit, and may be judged again at the next applicable cutoff or receipt procedure.
GP-06 전체는 아직 열려 있지만 소유자가 고른 일곱 정책은 별도로 고: GP-06 as a whole is still open, but the seven policies chosen by the owner are fixed separately. A cargo split retires the parent and creates two children that continue its origin, and receipt requires the recipient's confirmation signature. A reservation conflict shows the reason for the conflict and a new path for submitting intent, and does not place the request in an automatic queue. The cutoff uses a common daily phase, and a blockade and an arrival at the same time follow the inflow approval order. Cargo that fails receipt verification is quarantined locally, and undelivered reservations are kept in a pending-evidence state. These choices do not approve the receipt identification protocol, the authentication method, clock and phase values, error limits, implementation, or canon adoption.
진행 중인 전투에 실제로 도착하는 어느 부대도 그 전투에 참가할 수 있다: Any unit that actually arrives at a battle in progress may take part in it. Eligibility is not narrowed by origin, rank, the initial roster, or an arbitrarily created time window. A unit that arrives after the battle has ended does not retroactively join the finished battle. The arrival cadence, entry position, pre-command-transfer timing, and capacity formula have not been decided yet.
이동·조우·관측의 난수 목적은 전투·세계 사건·인물 난수 목적과 분리한다: The random-number purposes for movement, encounters, and observation are kept separate from those for battles, world events, and characters. The same starting value and the same choice record must be replayable, but the algorithm, seed encoding, draw order, and consumption conventions have not been decided yet.
**전.** 부대는 경로 후보의 출발점에 실제로 있고, 그 후보의 통행: **Before.** The unit is actually at the starting point of the route candidate, and the passage check for that candidate has not been completed yet. The remote unit is out of contact, and one cargo is in transit. The evaluating party has not directly seen the latest state of the destination.
**행동.** 플레이어가 이동을 제안하면 부대의 실제 위치와 거리·수단·: **Action.** When the player proposes a movement, the unit's actual position and the distance, means, load, fatigue, and route state are read. Until GP-02 decides route legality and how blockages are handled, no definitive result is produced. An approved movement must leave real route progress behind and is not completed by a screen transition. A strategic order sent to a remote unit is not executed until the contact route, receipt, and acceptance are in place. When a sourced report arrives, only the evaluating party's knowledge and confirmation time are updated. If cargo is verified and arrives at the same time as the deadline, it is included in that deadline; if it arrives after the deadline, it is excluded from that deadline. A unit that actually arrives at a battle in progress may take part in it.
**후.** 승인된 실제 이동을 마친 부대만 새 위치에 있다. GP-02: **After.** Only a unit that has finished an approved, actual movement is at the new position. Until GP-02 is closed, this document does not fix the exact remaining position or remaining progress in blockage cases. A remote order that was not executed remains unexecuted. A report has a source and a confirmation time and is distinguished from world facts. The quantity, ownership, custody, and source identity of arrived cargo are preserved. Late cargo remains in a state where it can be used in the next determination.
경로 적법성·막힘·실패 이동의 정산은 GP-02가 정한다. 승인 전에는: The settlement of route legality, blockages, and failed movements is decided by GP-02. Until it is approved, none of the following is applied as a fixed rule: remaining at the origin, stopping at the blocked point, or preserving the remaining segment.
A strategic order without a contact route, receipt, and acceptance is not executed.
A handover that points to the wrong asset or receipt record is not applied to that cargo.
마감 뒤 도착은 해당 마감에서 제외할 뿐 화물을 파괴하거나 영원히 운송: Arrival after the deadline only excludes the cargo from that deadline; it does not destroy the cargo or leave it permanently stuck in transit.
끝난 전투에 도착한 부대는 그 전투에 참가하지 않지만 부대 자체는 그대로: A unit that arrives at a finished battle does not take part in that battle, but the unit itself continues to exist as it is.
세계 행동이 취소되거나 배우가 사망해도 이미 완료된 진행과 이미 소비된: Even if a world action is canceled or an actor dies, progress that has already been completed and resources that have already been consumed are not recreated or restored. The settlement of the remaining in-progress steps is decided by the relevant action, life, asset, and time contracts.
Save-version conflicts and tampered re-transmissions of the same event are rejected at the technical boundary. This is not a universal game rule that rewinds every world action to before the action.
정보·소유·지휘·전쟁의 경계: Boundaries of Information, Ownership, Command, and War
지도 표시는 경로 자료이지 아직 미결인 GP-02의 통행 판정을 대신하지: A map marking is route data; it does not replace the passage determination of GP-02, which is still undecided. A report is not the whole current world, and ownership is not physical arrival. Item rights are recorded separately from position and command authority.
본체가 전투 지휘관이면 해당 전투 세션에 등록된 지휘 범위 안에 있으면서: If the main body is a battle commander, it can send valid orders and immediate signals only to those squads that are both within the command range registered in that battle session and on that session's attached squad list. Enemy forces, unattached independent or allied forces, allied forces outside the command range, and other main bodies or other sites are not command targets. Squad leader autonomy and order-result evaluation are valid immediately. To start a war, a registered valid casus belli is required, binding the target territory, eligible beneficiary, objective, and ending effect. War score ranges from −100 to +100, and the opponent's score has the opposite sign. When it reaches +100 or −100, the validity of the referenced casus belli and the eligibility of the beneficiary whose name is fixed in that casus belli are re-checked first. If the casus belli is invalid, no groundless forced transfer is created and the relevant invalidity rule is applied. If the casus belli is valid, the end cannot be postponed by accumulating response delays, and the war is forcibly ended within the effects of that casus belli and the fixed war objective scope. A victorious commander or occupier does not automatically acquire the objective rights in place of the beneficiary named in the casus belli, and territory or rights outside the objective are not automatically transferred either. Item-by-item custom negotiation is allowed, but an unregistered item price blocks signing, and an offer is not automatically accepted merely because its value is at or below the war score.
**막힌 철도 정책 비교.** 지도에 선로와 붕괴 보고가 있다. 선로 표: **Blocked Railway Policy Comparison.** The map shows a track and a collapse report. A track marking alone does not make a route candidate or a passage permit; the physical connection to the verified, actual next station and the current passability and right of passage are checked separately. Under the actual-movement principle, a unit cannot get to the other side by a screen transition alone. However, whether to refuse at the origin, to proceed to the blocked point, and in which record to leave the cause, risk, and recovery conditions are GP-02 alternatives, and this example does not approve them.
**늦은 화물.** 마감이 세계 시각 480이고 화물이 481에 도착했다: **Late Cargo.** The deadline is world time 480, and the cargo arrived at 481. This cargo is not included in the 480 deadline, but it keeps its actual position and identity until the next applicable deadline.
**동시 도착.** 화물이 마감 시각과 같은 480에 검증되었다. 도착: **Simultaneous Arrival.** The cargo was verified at 480, the same time as the deadline. Reservation, production, and consumption proceed after arrival verification, so the cargo can be used in that deadline. 480 is an example for explaining the boundary, not an approved day length or transport speed.
**전투 증원.** 최초 명단에 없던 부대가 전투가 진행 중일 때 실제: **Battle Reinforcement.** A unit that was not on the initial roster actually arrived while the battle was in progress. It may take part regardless of origin and rank. If it arrived after the battle ended, it does not take part in that battle.
**이름 검색.** 플레이어가 같은 이름을 가진 두 사람을 검색한다. 목: **Name Search.** The player searches for two people with the same name. Both appear in the list, and after selection each record is resolved by a different stable identifier.
**취소와 소비.** 여행 준비 중 식량 일부가 이미 소비된 뒤 계획이: **Cancellation and Consumption.** After part of the food had already been consumed during travel preparation, the plan was canceled. Cancellation does not restore the food that was eaten, nor does it erase the completed preparation progress. Only the remaining steps are halted and settled according to the relevant contract.
두 원작에서 확인한 현재 근거: Current Evidence Confirmed from the Two Source Games
설치본 1.20.0.3, 빌드 25652598의 보존 자료에서 `MOVE: In the preserved data of installed version 1.20.0.3, build 25652598, defined values such as `MOVEMENT_SPEED=3`, retreat speed `4.5`, friendly territory bonus `0.2`, and movement lock `0.5` can be confirmed, but the full travel-time formula cannot. The AI employer's movement preparation computes `Q=distance/300` from the squared distance to the capital, and when current provisions are less than Q, it **adds** Q and then starts the journey together with the residence. This is neither a general consumption formula nor a shortfall-replenishment formula. The conditions and completion events of activity-start waiting, guest delay, and transport arrival have been confirmed, but Seoul's exact deadline-comparison formula and same-time ordering have not. Cost and risk unit conflicts in the preserved wiki were also left unresolved. These values are not Seoul's figures.
서로 다른 판본의 자료를 한 판본처럼 합치지 않았다. 도로의 흙길 `+2: Data from different versions were not merged as if they were a single version. The road's dirt path `+20%` and stone path `+40%` come from wiki revision 1385, and nectar `+30%/36 hours` comes from resource wiki revision 1129. The removal of the nectar movement bonus is from the **Patches 46-48 (MAIN)** announcement. The same announcement explains that if a raider squad's natural travel time is shorter than 24 hours, it is made to stand still until the total travel time is at least 24 hours, but the exact waiting arrangement and the equality condition at the boundary time have not been confirmed. It also says that only **crime-scene markers** are shown in the king's vision for the following 24 hours, and this is not to be read as a universal validity period for all observation information. Movement between buildings `−75%`, the road exception, and elderly movement `−15%` are from the **Patches 54-56 (MAIN)** announcement. The trade availability `11 AM` is from trade wiki revision 1275, and the historical parameter capture is build 25211575. The distance unit, the load-speed coupling formula, and the remaining-segment accumulator have not been confirmed. These revisions, announcements, and historical captures are separate document boundaries and are not authoritative for the current world state, and the original figures are not Seoul's figures either.
두 게임의 자료는 비교 근거일 뿐 서울의 단일 화물 정체성 보존, 도착-: The data from the two games serve only as comparison evidence and do not approve Seoul's single cargo identity preservation, arrival-first settlement, or war and command locks on its behalf.
각 항목은 실제 쓰임, 이상적인 완료 상태, 현재 간극, 열린 이유, Q: Each item records its actual use, ideal completed state, current gap, reason it is open, and QA together. The GP-06 policy that has already been chosen is excluded from the alternatives below, and this document does not approve the remaining alternatives.
**경로 적법성·막힘·실패 정산.** 전제: 지도 선, 역 표식, 알려진: **Route Legality, Blockage, and Failure Settlement.** Premise: map lines, station markers, and the known existence of track alone do not create an adjacent connection or passage permit. Only the physical adjacent connection to the actual next station, whose source, version, and verification status have been confirmed, can become a route candidate. An express train's service that skips intermediate stations is not a movement edge, and the service line, physical connection, and current passage status are distinguished. Unconfirmed connections are not displayed or used for movement. The current passability and right of passage of a route candidate are checked separately. Use: whether a movement proposal is accepted and the state after interruption. Ideal: determine route authority, blockage, remaining progress, and information time in a replayable way while upholding the actual-movement principle. Alternatives: (A) full-route check and refusal before departure, (B) approve only the known segments and stop at the blocked point, (C) per-segment approval along the route and re-proposal of a detour. Gap/reason: GP-02 owns this policy and no choice has been made yet. QA: do not create movement edges or passage permits from unconfirmed connections, station markers, or track geometry; no screen-transition teleportation; distinguish stale reports from actual blockages; remaining progress matches before and after saving.
**개인 이동 산식.** 쓰임: 도착 예상과 잔여 구간 저장. 이상: 거: **Personal Movement Formula.** Use: arrival estimation and saving the remaining segment. Ideal: a verifiable formula that uses distance, means, load, fatigue, and route together. Alternatives: (A) discrete per-segment cost, (B) continuous movement rate and remaining distance, (C) standard timetable by means followed by load and fatigue adjustment. Gap/reason: without the GURPS Basic source text, the Basic-dependent numbers cannot be closed. QA: reproducibility for the same input, no arrival on unapproved routes, remaining progress matches before and after saving and loading.
설치본 1.20.0.3·빌드 25652598의 문서·스크립트 조사다. 다: This is a survey of the documentation and scripts for installed build 1.20.0.3 (build 25652598). However, the higher-level context used in the earlier manual survey, the active branch, DLC, mods, and runtime observations were not confirmed, so the document-level comparison is not extended to the full runtime behavior. The staff of a court position are characters, and there are candidate conditions and a check against duplicate occupation of the canonical position. The salary's default value, conditional branches, and modifiers, as well as the gold/treasury payment path, are confirmed in the documentation. However, hiring, replacement, and appointment do not demonstrate an algorithm for extracting residents from aggregate counts or returning them under the same ID. The current-state variables for task start and end are also not a half-open reservation ledger. The abstract quantity of army supply is not the same as deduplicating residents' meals and rations. The raw troop figure of 100+75=175 from estate buildings is neither the final troop count nor a resident count. What Seoul takes from this is a comparative perspective of reading candidate eligibility and actual payment separately, not those salary or troop figures.
공식 커뮤니티 위키 Population oldid 1316·Warfare: This is a documentation-based survey using the official community wiki's Population oldid 1316 and Warfare oldid 1319, plus the developers' patch notes. Only the raw-text container of Population oldid 1316 is currently unreadable, so it relies on the exact excerpts that were preserved. In neither case is this a result of verifying the actual behavior of the running build as a whole. The population is represented by individual characters and five categories. The training-ground requirement, the permanent recruitment conversion of peasants and prisoners, and the fix for ranged proxies returning after battle are confirmed, but they are not equivalent to Seoul's temporary muster and same-ID aggregate return. After research, wage selection and direct distribution both remain. The wage cycle, unpaid wages, and the complete payment function are unconfirmed.
MAIN43–45의 농민 식량 하루 1개와 집 보관, Summer의 분배: The one-per-day peasant food and home storage in MAIN43–45, the suppression of market purchases after distribution in Summer, and the caravan duplicate-purchase fix in MAIN54–56 are limited comparisons of duplicate prevention. They do not demonstrate a consumption ledger for all residents or a tribe-wide ration allocation. Prisoners collecting directly from the storehouse differs between versions and from the earlier wiki's warden requirement, so it is not mixed into the conditions of any one version. The daytime assignment of the unemployed, retention of the already employed, and nighttime readjustment in MAIN50–53 are not evidence of half-open exclusive reservations. The rule in MAIN35 of one migrant per 10 points starting from a daily average peasant mood of 30 also does not complete a rounding or whole-population event formula. Do not mix MAIN's refund at the first hour with BETA57's refund at any time while in transit. These original figures are not adopted as Seoul's consumption amounts, migration rates, or refund policy.
다음 대안은 어느 것도 확정 정책이나 기본값이 아니다. 개인 능력·건강에: None of the following alternatives is a confirmed policy or default. The arithmetic for deriving wage, ration, and headcount figures from individual ability and health has also not yet been decided.
**임금·배급·부족(GP-04).** 대안 A는 역할 계약별 임금과 필수: **Wages, Rations, and Shortages (GP-04).** Alternative A is wages by role contract plus a bundle of essential items; B is a wage table by institution plus rations by need. It is used in D02 Living Constraints and D05 Demand Settlement. The ideal is to distinguish payment, arrival, consumption, and unmet need, and to settle without duplication. The gaps are the amounts, item ratios, periods, shortage duration, and labor-reduction coefficients. It remains an alternative because neither the system nor the figures have been chosen, and there is no basis for carrying the original's numbers over to Seoul's.
**개인화·복귀 절차(GP-04).** A는 본인 지원 후 담당자 수락,: **Personalization and Return Procedure (GP-04).** A is self-application followed by acceptance by the officer in charge; B is a proposal by a valid assignment authority followed by acceptance by the individual and the institution. It is used for jobs and musters and for institutional rosters. The ideal is to preserve the same ID and population carried over from the aggregate stage, and to make clear who initiates, accepts, and records. The gaps are the ID issuance algorithm, the right to initiate, the recording location, roster registration, and return conditions. It remains an alternative because approval of aggregate-stage IDs and identity continuity alone cannot determine institutional procedures and data formats.
**정원·재편(GP-08).** A는 세 입력의 구간별 정원표, B는 세: **Headcount and Reorganization (GP-08).** A is a headcount table by bracket over three inputs; B is continuous calculation over the three inputs followed by integer conversion. It is used for organization, reinforcement, and reorganization after a commander is lost. The ideal is that the basis of the inputs is visible and that excess personnel are preserved. The gaps are the types of ability, the definition of national/settlement level, the formula, rounding, and cost. It remains an alternative because only the three directions are confirmed and there is no computational relationship.
**모집 동의·장비·증원 세목(GP-08).** A는 개인 복무 계약과: **Recruitment Consent, Equipment, and Reinforcement Details (GP-08).** A is an individual service contract with institutional equipment loans; B is an institutional service procedure with personal equipment use. It is used for actual organization and entry into battle. The ideal is to explain consent, equipment rights, and command scope each separately. The gaps are the conditions of consent, equipment provision and return, entry deployment, and transfer of command. It remains an alternative because the rule that any unit that actually arrives may join a battle in progress does not decide these details.
**인구 사건.** A는 사건 발생 즉시 반영, B는 사건 시각을 남기고: **Population Events.** A is reflecting an event immediately when it occurs; B is recording the event time and summing at designated boundaries. It is used for total population, location, and recruit changes. The ideal is that representational movement is separated from actual birth, death, migration, and capture. The gaps are the occurrence conditions, rates, cycles, and attribution of counts. It remains an alternative because the conservation rule alone cannot determine the event generation rate or when events are reflected.
**명부 편입과 인구 생성.** A는 담당 기관이 확인된 개인 신원과 현: **Roster Enrollment and Population Generation.** In A, the responsible institution enrolls individuals in the roster one at a time based on confirmed personal identity and current eligibility; in B, candidates are generated from confirmed group records, and each individual's current location, rights, and training are rechecked before enrollment. It is used for cast, unit, and settlement rosters and for attributing new population events. The ideal is that the initiator, decision authority, target identity, and pre- and post-enrollment states are visible, and that historical records are not automatically converted into current rights. The gaps are which institution initiates and decides, the state when a candidate is rejected or duplicated, and which count the new population is attributed to. It remains an alternative because past rosters alone cannot establish current persons, abilities, and rights.
D05 경제·생산·건설·자원 — 서울 작동 설계: D05 Economy, Production, Construction, and Resources — Seoul Operating Design
【승인】은 이미 받아들인 행동 범위, 【제안】은 미채택 대안, 【미결】은: 【Approved】 marks the scope of actions already accepted, 【Proposed】 marks an alternative not yet adopted, and 【Open】 marks parts where a needed contract or figure is missing. Example quantities are not adopted as prices, production rates, or periods.
【승인】 플레이어는 한 명의 본체로 행동하고 NPC도 같은 행동 계약을: 【Approved】 The player acts as a single body, and NPCs follow the same action contract. Distinguish the person performing the construction or repair, the authority who approves orders, the individual or institution that owns the assets, and the person who stores or transports goods. Institutional assets remain with the institution. Ordering construction does not confer ownership or qualification to perform it.
플레이어의 판단은 단계 진행·중단 요청, 생산 주문의 우선순위 변경, 도: The player's judgments are requesting that a stage proceed or halt, changing the priority of production orders, and checking which consumption deadline an arrival can be used for. The request authority and the concrete criteria for selecting performers are 【Open】. The ability to find people, facilities, and cargo by name is a 【Proposed】 information convenience and is not yet an approved interface. Whether something is actually the same entity is determined by its permanent ID. Past rosters do not substitute for current survival, position, authority, or supply status.
전투에는 일시정지·속도 조절·명령 대기열이 없다. 캠페인 시간 제어 정책: Combat has no pause, speed control, or command queue. The campaign time-control policy is not decided by this approval. Economic deadlines are not strategy turns that stop movement under a single world clock. In D15 Combat, every squad within the registered command scope assigned to a commander is a selectable target, and orders reach the squad leader immediately, but the squad leader acts autonomously and is evaluated per commander. Any unit that actually arrives at a battle in progress is a reinforcement target. In D16 War, the valid casus belli, the authority to declare war, the named eligible beneficiary, and the fixed objective scope are checked first. If this prior check fails, the war is not initiated, so it does not enter the forced ending at war score ±100 or the individual negotiation stage either. Even a validly initiated war has the casus belli's continued validity, the named beneficiary's current eligibility, and the fixed objective scope rechecked immediately before the forced effect is applied. If the recheck fails, the earlier effect is not forced by the ±100 value alone. Only a war that passes the recheck is forcibly ended at war score +100 or -100 with the corresponding casus belli effect and fixed objective scope, and in between it is negotiated individually using registered items. These boundaries are contracts of the combat and war owning domains and are not to be replaced with D05's inventory and reservation formulas or authority.
2. 예약·소유·보관·소비·진척: 2. Reservation, Ownership, Storage, Consumption, and Progress
아직 수행하지 않은 특정 건설 일을 맡아 둔 상태. 생산 주문 수량과 다: A state in which specific construction work not yet performed has been set aside. It differs from the quantity of a production order
필수 소비·계약·보급 또는 승인 주문을 위해 잡아 둔 입력 수량: Input quantities set aside for essential consumption, contracts, supply, or approved orders
물자·시설의 법적 소유자가 누구인지. 보관자·운반자·열쇠 소지자와 다를: Who is the legal owner of the goods or facility. May differ from the custodian, the carrier, and the key holder
물건이 실제 어디에 있고 누구에게 전달되었는지. 권리만으로 도착을 만들지: Where the goods actually are and to whom they were handed over. Rights alone do not create arrival
해당 작업에 실제 투입되어 이미 사용된 노동·도구·재료. 자동 환급 대상: Labor, tools, and materials actually put into the work and already used. Not subject to automatic refund
끝난 작업과 아직 쓰지 않은 물건. 중단·취소·사망 때 소비분과 따로 보: Work that is finished and goods not yet used. Preserved separately from the consumed portion upon suspension, cancellation, or death
【승인】 승인과 실행 사이에 사망·해임·점령·연락 두절이 생기면 예약 작: 【Approved】 If death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the reserved work is rechecked. Goods already consumed and completed progress are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released under that contract. Suspension, resumption, occupation, and transfer handle progress, material ownership, and workforce reservations separately. Occupation or the death of the person in charge alone does not hand unused materials to a new owner.
3. 건설·수리: 자격과 전/행동/후: 3. Construction and Repair: Qualification and Before/Action/After
【승인】 단계마다 실제 노동·도구·재료를 소비한다. 자격 인력과 필수 입: 【Approved】 Each stage consumes actual labor, tools, and materials. Only stages with qualified personnel and required inputs in place proceed. 【Open】 The stage list, costs and durations, conversion from labor to progress, how tools are consumed, performer selection, authority to request suspension, and the dismantling recovery rate have not been decided.
**진행 요청.** 전: 진행 가능한 단계와 자격 인력·필수 입력을 확인: **Proceed Request.** Before: Check the stages that can proceed, the qualified personnel, and the required inputs. Action: Consume only what was actually put into that stage. After: Distinguish the materials used from those remaining, and calculate progress according to the confirmed stage contract. Do not add the input amount directly to the progress amount or create an arbitrary minimum progress.
**중단.** 전: 진행 중인 단계에 완료 진척과 이미 쓴 입력, 미사용: **Suspension.** Before: The stage in progress has completed progress, already-spent inputs, and unused materials, each separately. Action: If an authorized suspension request is established, progress stops. After: Preserve the completed progress and unused materials, and do not automatically refund labor, tools, and materials already spent. Who takes over the remaining work and the transfer of ownership are separate decisions.

  "orderedSteps": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "operation": "validate",
      "detail": "Parse types/units and all checkpoint diagnostics; accumulate independent load errors without live mutation."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "operation": "time",
      "detail": "Read exact stored numeric tick/residual; earliest supplied valid due event moves clock, empty candidate set NO_WORK. No wall-clock conversion or fixed turn invented."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "operation": "admit",
      "detail": "For independent same-time proposals whose causes already applied, preserve unique durable ingress order. Existing acceptance sequence never reordered. Ambiguous new causal graph returns HELD_BY_DECISION; no event-kind death/arrival priority invented."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "operation": "recheck",
      "detail": "Read snapshot revision, current command/CB/beneficiary/authority/eligibility. Same-time cargo verification precedes reservation/production/consumption only in approved cutoff scope."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "operation": "deduplicate",
      "detail": "Existing event/result/address + same payload returns stored result. Changed payload rejects, never creates a second result."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "operation": "rng",
      "detail": "A recorded purpose/entity/state/event/label address returns recorded value; new numeric draw remains blocked pending algorithm/seed/extraction approval."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "operation": "commit",
      "detail": "Apply owner-domain effect once, persist state/result/receipt together. Do not use identity +0 counters as restore or settlement."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "operation": "save-load",
      "detail": "After complete acceptance/result boundary preserve every open phase, consumed quantity, progress, reservations and accepted prefix. Verify temporary candidate before replacement; any load error preserves live state and previous backup."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "operation": "project",
      "detail": "Restore world and knowledge separately; display only current-body knowledge and access. Closing/loading is not a world death/exit."
    }
  ],

**Strategic Message Details.** Use: recipient, acceptor, duplicate orders, delegation expiry. Ideal: an explicit procedure that preserves real contact and NPC judgment. Alternatives: (A) the most recently accepted order takes priority, (B) keep dispatch order, (C) on conflict, treat as a negotiation state. Gap/reason: all that has been approved is the contact path, receipt, and the need for acceptance. QA: no execution on a severed contact; determinism for duplicate and expired cases after reconnection.
**GP-06 남은 세부.** 쓰임: 영수 식별, 인증, 오류 한도, 공: **GP-06 Remaining Details.** Use: receipt identification, authentication, error limits, and the actual time of the shared daily phase. Ideal: complete the seven already-selected policies within quantity conservation and the separation of ownership and custody. Alternatives: receipt identification via (A) a separate receipt event ID, (B) a composite key of cargo ID and receipt version, (C) a pair of signature event and cargo reference. Error handling via (A) per-item resubmission, (B) resubmission in batches by cause, (C) resubmission by verification stage. Gap/reason: the owner selection exists, but the full GP-06, the authentication method, the clock and phase values, the error limits, and the implementation and canon adoption remain open. QA: quantity conservation before and after splitting, no use before signing, no consumption of quarantined cargo, retention of undelivered reservations.
**증원 세션.** 쓰임: 전장 진입과 지휘 인계. 이상: '실제 도착한: **Reinforcement Session.** Use: battlefield entry and command handover. Ideal: a procedure that does not undermine "any unit that actually arrives may take part." Alternatives: (A) enter at the next battle update point, (B) enter immediately at a safe edge, (C) the commander chooses the entry point. Gap/reason: there is no cycle, geometry, handover, or capacity count. QA: confirm that no filters on origin, rank, or initial roster arise.
**같은 시각의 나머지 총순서.** 쓰임: 도착 검증 뒤 예약·생산·소비: **Remaining Total Order at the Same Time.** Use: event conflicts that remain after first applying the economic phase (reserve, produce, consume after arrival verification) and the inflow approval order for blockade and arrival at the same time. Ideal: preserve these two approval orders as they are while sorting only the remaining events in a replayable way. Alternatives: after applying the two approval orders, (A) process the remaining events in causal-event order, (B) process the remaining events by domain phase and stable identifier order, (C) process the remaining events in input-receipt order. Gap/reason: the full ordering of events remaining after the two approval orders is unapproved. QA: preservation of arrival verification → reservation → production → consumption, preservation of the blockade and arrival inflow approval order, identical results when replaying the remaining same-time events, no multiplication from duplicate arrivals.

D07 관계·기억·충성·평가 — 독자용 설계 문서: D07 Relationships, Memory, Loyalty, and Evaluation — Design Document for Readers
관계·기억·충성·명령 평가의 승인 범위를 설명한다. 미채택 기작과 수치는: This document explains the approved scope of relationships, memory, loyalty, and command evaluation. Unadopted mechanisms and values remain undetermined.
D07은 세 가지를 소유한다. 첫째, 무언가를 실제로 알게 된 인물의 신: D07 owns three things. First, the trust and memory of a character who has actually come to know something. Second, loyalty to a lord, which is a separate state. Third, the record of compliance and performance for a single order that a squad leader received in battle. What relationships do not create — the establishment of command authority, property rights, consent, right of passage, or marriage — lies outside this document, and Chapters 8 and 9 draw that boundary precisely.
읽는 순서는 다음과 같다. 2장에서 행위자를, 3장에서 플레이어가 실제로: The reading order is as follows. Chapter 2 covers the actors, Chapter 3 the decisions the player actually makes, and Chapter 4 eligibility. Chapters 5 and 6 are the structure of actions and the already-approved states and formulas, and Chapters 7 and 8 are the boundaries of failure, preservation, information, and authority. Chapter 9 covers cross-domain ownership, Chapter 10 four concrete cases, Chapter 11 external references (Crusader Kings III, Norland), Chapter 12 open issues and decision-ready alternatives, and Chapter 13 a summary of the boundary between what is settled and what is open.
**플레이어(본체 인물).** 한 명의 플레이어가 한 몸의 인물로 캠페인: **Player (the Embodied Character).** A single player carries the campaign forward as a character with one body. The embodied character uses the same action contract as the other characters in the world, and gains no authority outside the contract by virtue of being the embodied character.
**NPC.** 세계의 나머지 인물 전부다. 본체와 동일한 행동 계약을: **NPCs.** All the remaining characters in the world. They use the same action contract as the embodied character. NPCs, too, can hold, refuse, or negotiate an order. They do not rewind time by switching screens, nor create a second copy of the same body in a distant place.
**분대장.** 전투에서 상위 지휘관의 명령을 즉시 신호로 받는 역할이다: **Squad Leader.** The role that receives a superior commander's orders in battle instantly as a signal. The embodied character may be the squad leader, and an NPC may be the squad leader. Receiving an order does not lock input or force the order to be executed.
**상위 지휘관(발신자).** 전투 명령을 내리는 인물이다. 명령에 대한: **Superior Commander (Sender).** The character who issues battle orders. The result of evaluating an order goes back to this commander's character, and this commander builds up memory about the executing squad's body and the basis for later assignment and trust judgments.
**평가 주체(관측자·보고 수신자).** 어떤 일을 실제로 직접 보았거나: **Evaluator (Observer / Report Recipient).** A character who has actually seen something directly or learned of it through a report. At the moment they come to know it, they update only their own trust and their own memory. They do not correct anyone else's trust on their behalf.
**군주.** 충성 상태의 대상이다. 영웅마다 자기 군주에 대한 충성 값: **Lord.** The object of the loyalty state. Each hero has a separate loyalty value toward their own lord, and the lord's own loyalty is always at the maximum.
**국가·기관·제도(설정 사실의 소유자).** 혼인, 맹세, 지휘 관계의: **States, institutions, and systems (owners of setting facts).** The country-specific systems that determine the establishment and termination of marriage, oaths, and command relationships are facts of the world setting. A relationship fact that has already been validly established and stored is not deleted or downgraded to an unestablished record just because the system input is undetermined. However, if a request to establish a new relationship is made and it is not sufficiently clear which system applies, or what the basis for establishment under that system is, the request is left as `Jedo Mijeong/Hwagin Geungeo Bujok` (system undetermined / insufficient basis for confirmation). This document does not invent that system.
**전투 하달에 대한 세 갈래 선택.** 본체가 분대장이면 상위 지휘관의: **Three-Way Choice on a Battle Order.** If the embodied character is the squad leader, they receive the superior commander's battle order instantly as a system signal, without the travel time of a messenger or radio. If the embodied character is the superior commander, they directly select squads that fall within the **intersection of the registered command scope of that battle session and the list of currently assigned squads**, and issue movement, stance, and attack orders. Allied forces, independent units, and enemy forces outside the registered scope are not command targets even if they are visible on screen. A subordinate squad leader, immediately after receiving an order, also runs the same feasibility check and exercises autonomous judgment. There is no pause, speed control, or order queue in battle. After receiving the order, they (1) follow it as is, (2) carry out only part of it, or (3) act on their own. These three branches are the decisions the player actually makes in this document. This instant delivery applies only to battle orders, and does not make distant contact on the strategic map or character movement instantaneous.
**알게 된 사실의 처리.** 본체가 어떤 일을 직접 보거나 보고로 알게: **Handling of Learned Facts.** When the embodied character sees something directly or learns of it through a report, their own trust and their own memory are updated at the moment they learn of it. This update is a result, not a choice. The choices come before it — what to watch, whose reports to receive, and what to conceal. A concealed betrayal does not change anyone's trust until another person learns of it.
**보류·거절·교섭의 기록.** 안전·생리·구금처럼 지금 수행할 수 없는: **Record of Holding, Refusal, and Negotiation.** Conditions that make it impossible to carry out right now, such as safety, physiology, or detention, come first. When needs, goals, or an already-set schedule collide with an order, it is recorded as holding, refusal, or negotiation. An order does not erase that person's personal goals. The player reads this record and decides the next action.
**평가하려면 알아야 한다.** 평가하는 사람은 그 일을 실제로 알아야: **One Must Know in Order to Evaluate.** The person evaluating must actually know about the matter. The approach of instantly knowing a hidden betrayal from somewhere in the world is not used. Coming to know an event through observation or reports is the condition for a relationship update. The attribution of responsibility for a report and the weighting of its evidence have not yet been determined.
**신뢰는 지휘권을 만들지 않는다.** 명령을 내릴 수 있는지는 신뢰 수: **Trust Does Not Create Command Authority.** Whether one can issue an order does not arise from a trust value. The type of command authority, its direction, the scope of delegation, the contact that actually reaches, and the target's state are examined separately. Looking someone up or opening a conversation does not create command authority. High trust also does not make a physically impossible task succeed. High trust does not create property, consent, or right of passage either.
**수행 불능이 우선한다.** 같은 몸이라도 안전, 생리, 구금처럼 지금: **Inability to Perform Takes Priority.** Even for the same body, conditions that make it impossible to carry out right now, such as safety, physiology, or detention, come first. These conditions block eligibility to execute an order; they are not an evaluation of that person's will.
**하달 수신의 기록.** 전투 명령을 받을 때는 일곱 가지가 함께 기록: **Record of Order Receipt.** When a battle order is received, seven items are recorded together — world time, superior order identifier, sender commander, target squad, purpose, permitted scope, and version. Only with this record is it possible to avoid duplicate application of the same result and to re-check after a change of commander.
5. 행동의 구조: 이전 / 행동 / 이후: 5. Structure of Actions: Before / Action / After
하달 → 즉시 수신(일곱 필드 기록) → 따름/일부 수행/독자 행동 선택: Order issued → immediate receipt (seven fields recorded) → choose follow / partial execution / independent action → actual execution → per-order evaluation → reflected in the commander's memory and relationships. No new battle order queue is created; only the current issued/executing state and the update history are kept. The same order evaluation is never applied twice by result identifier.
5.2 관측·보고의 갱신 전이: 5.2 Update Transitions of Observation and Reports
사건 발생(행위자·대상·피해/수혜·목격/보고·비밀 범위·근거 기록) →: Event occurs (record of actor, target, harm/benefit, witness/report, secrecy scope, and evidence) → the evaluator comes to know it through observation or a report → at that moment, only their own trust and their own memory are updated → the updated facts are read again as input to later action judgments.
이 문서의 승인 범위는 네 장면에서 가장 분명해진다. 10장에서 이 네: The approved scope of this document becomes clearest in four scenes. Chapter 10 revisits these four scenes as worked cases.
**같은 보고가 두 번 도착한다.** 같은 결과 식별자는 한 번만 적용한: **The Same Report Arrives Twice.** The same result identifier is applied only once. An evaluation that arrives again produces no second change. Resending the same event identifier does not become a new result.
**늦은 비밀 발견.** 을이 숨겨 둔 배신이 갑이 직접 보지 못했고 보: **Late Discovery of a Secret.** If a betrayal that Eul concealed was not seen directly by Gap and no report reached Gap, Gap's trust does not change. That the matter becomes public reputation and that Gap suffered direct harm are different records. No fixed national character or betrayal probability is assigned.
**후계자에게 개인 신뢰를 복사하지 않는다.** 사망자의 개인 신뢰는 후: **Personal Trust Is Not Copied to a Successor.** The personal trust of the deceased is not copied to the successor. The new body starts from the personal relationships it already had. The previous character's contracts, institutional obligations, and public history are each carried over by their own succession policies.
**불가능한 명령과 거역한 명령.** 수행할 수 없는 명령, 그리고 발신: **Impossible Orders and Defied Orders.** An order that cannot be carried out, and an order that became void after the issuing commander died, are execution failures. They are not deliberate defiance. Even if independent action produced a good result, compliance and performance remain separate records. Disobedience does not automatically reduce trust by a fixed amount.

이 절은 승인된 산문을 판정에 바로 쓸 수 있게 상태와 전이로 옮긴 **: This section is a **design output** that converts the approved prose into states and transitions so it can be used directly for adjudication. 제도의 성립 판정(제도 미정이면 불가): The regime's establishment ruling (impossible if the regime is undecided)

핵심 전이 규칙(【승인】범위의 서술):: Core transition rules (description within the 【Approved】 scope):

D13의 재산 계약(자산별 서명 계약·유언·담보 방향은 소유자 선택, §: D13's property contract (per-asset signed contract, will, or security direction is the owner's choice, §4 table)

6. 정본 산문의 표본 시나리오 — 국경을 넘는 동의·인준: 6. Sample Scenario from the Canonical Prose — Cross-Border Consent and Ratification
This scenario is a verbatim transcription of canonical prose b27–b31 (【Approved】).
**전**: 두 사람이 살아 있고 서로 다른 나라에 속한다. 각 나라의: **Before**: Two people are alive and belong to different states. Each state has its own marriage regime. Which regime applies to this pair is unknown. Each has their own claims, property, and positions. Starting from the circumstance in which the marriage is not yet established is an **assumption** of this step, not a conclusion drawn from not knowing the regime.

**후**: 적용 제도를 모르므로 성립과 효과를 이 기록만으로 정할 수: **After**: Because the governing regime is unknown, establishment and effects cannot be decided from these records alone. The claim and territory restrictions attached only to an established marriage apply only after establishment is confirmed. Next, if one person loses their position while still alive, only that position's signing, command, and operation stop, and the loss of position does not determine the marriage's establishment or effects.

Version mismatches and corrupted saves are explicit errors, and resending the same event ID does not create a new outcome. 인물 사이 관계는 신뢰 `T[A,B]`로 읽는다. 갑이 을을 믿는 값과: Relationships between characters are read as trust, `T[A,B]`. The value with which A trusts B and the value with which B trusts A are separate.
