행정안전부 주민등록 인구통계 2026-08 총인구수 (거주자·거주불명자·: Ministry of the Interior and Safety resident registration population statistics, 2026-08 total population (including residents, persons of unknown residence, and overseas nationals; excluding foreigners); 30% projection · area within administrative-dong boundaries as of 2026-07-01 · https://jumin.mois.go.kr/statMonth.do
2097년 6월 수문국은 서울 양평역의 물길 업무 인원과 당산2동의 한강: In June 2097, the Sluice Bureau signed a contract with the waterway workers of Yangpyeong Station in Seoul and the Han riverside waterway workers of Dangsan 2-dong. The Yangpyeong side had 34 representatives and the Dangsan side had 51. The Sluice Bureau named the two working groups First Sluice and Second Sluice. In return for managing the Sluice Bureau's waterways, both groups were entered on the Yangpyeong ration roll. The contract was a division of duties and not a transfer of ownership of land, channels, or facilities.
2099년 3월 당산2동에서 제이수문 대신 당산이라는 지역명을 사용하자는: In March 2099, a demand was raised in Dangsan 2-dong to use the regional name Dangsan instead of Second Sluice. More than 1,100 residents on the Dangsan side signed the petition. The Sluice Bureau contract council rejected it, with 2 votes in favor and 7 against.
2099년 3월 지역명 사용 요구가 기각된 뒤에도 당산2동의 뱃사람과 시: Even after the demand to use the regional name was rejected in March 2099, the boatmen and market merchants of Dangsan 2-dong keep using the name Dangsan on their goods and signboards. The waterway duty contract made with the Sluice Bureau in 2097 remains, but the name in the contract fails to unify residents' daily life. Merchants who come from Guro learn that the Second Sluice in the contract and the Dangsan they hear in the marketplace refer to the same working group.
2106년 훗날 세 국가를 이루는 각 진영 내부에서 전투가 벌어졌다. 규: In 2106, fighting broke out within each camp of what would later become the three states. The Standards League, the Central Intelligence Agency, Taeuk Group, Seongha Group, Sinnae Transport, and the White Cross Order formed one camp. The Government of the Republic of Korea, the Sluice Bureau, the Eastern Office, the Agwan Office, the Transshipment Bureau, the Yeouido Investment Federation, and the Jeongdong Labor Federation formed another camp. Myeongbu Church, the Anguk Monastic Assembly, and the Myeongdong Archdiocese formed the religious alliance camp.
2111년 3월 수문국·동방사·아관사·환적국·신내운수·규격맹·흰십자단은: In March 2111, the Sluice Bureau, the Eastern Office, the Agwan Office, the Transshipment Bureau, Sinnae Transport, the Standards League, and the White Cross Order submitted the succession of their heads and the originals of the treaty to the Records Office. The Records Office returned sealed copies to each state.
2114년 6월 당산2동 한강변의 기존 수문 업무에 쓰는 화물 인계 공간: In June 2114, at the cargo handover space used for existing sluice duties on the Han riverside of Dangsan 2-dong, the refrigeration compressor for cargo storage stopped for a week. The Standards League changed the issuing order of replacement parts for Guro. The Central Intelligence Agency's Heukseok duty desk revised the refrigeration rotation. The Sluice Bureau's Yeongdeungpo duty desk cross-checked the operating hours of the drainage window. Taeuk Group quarantined the damaged seal hash box. The Yeouido Investment Federation circulated a notice deferring acceptance of the refrigerated cargo. Use of the work space did not grant ownership of the site or facilities.
2116년 규격맹·대한민국정부·종교 연합의 세 국가가 성립하였다. 규격맹: In 2116, three states were established: the Standards League, the Government of the Republic of Korea, and the Religious Alliance. The Standards League became the hegemon commanding the Sluice Bureau, Taeuk Group, and the Yeouido Investment Federation. The Government of the Republic of Korea became the hegemon commanding the Eastern Office, the Agwan Office, the Transshipment Bureau, the Anguk Monastic Assembly, Seongha Group, Sinnae Transport, and the White Cross Order. Myeongbu Church, the Myeongdong Archdiocese, and the Jeongdong Labor Federation remained in the Religious Alliance, and no single head was chosen. The existing heads and offices continued as vassals. The former territory of the Central Intelligence Agency was incorporated into the Standards League. The Central Intelligence Agency kept the neutrality it had maintained since 2030. The agency's AI led the organization by replacing only its avatar, and the current avatar, O Haerin, uses Namsan Tower as a base. The Government of the Republic of Korea took Gangbuk, centered on Cheongwadae, as its core region; the Standards League took the western part south of the Han River; and the Religious Alliance took the Gangnam area south of the Han River. These core regions did not imply that all affiliated persons lived there or that the whole district was exclusively owned, and existing member facilities, personal locations, and rights were left as they were.
2118년 2월 중앙정보부 원장 시험 응시자는 88명이었다. 수문국과 규: In February 2118, 88 candidates sat the Central Intelligence Agency director examination. Engineers from the Sluice Bureau and the Standards League took all of the top ten places.
In 2119, the Sluice Bureau contract council elected Han Jaemok as head of the Sluice Bureau.
같은 해 한재목은 이서담을 양천 구역장에 임명하였고, 이때 수문 개방 전: That same year, Han Jaemok appointed I Seodam as Yangcheon district chief, and at this time a procedure of obtaining the countersignature of ration-district representatives before opening a sluice was added to the Sluice Bureau regulations.
2122년 시험 합격 기술자 6명이 수문국 계약 회의와 규격맹 평의회의: In 2122, six engineers who had passed the examination were appointed clerks of the Sluice Bureau contract council and the Standards League council. The clerks drew up the minutes and voting records.
2122년 8월 온민의는 청사 경비대를 수문국 경계로 보내자는 안을 대통: In August 2122, On Minui submitted to President Yun Seorin a proposal to send the Government Complex Guard to the Sluice Bureau border. The guard's duty families submitted the Gwanghwamun, Jongno, and Jung-gu muster rolls. Yun Seorin did not sign the guard movement proposal.
2122년 9월 여의도출자연합회는 여의도 회관의 공동 접수 창구에 할당할: In September 2122, the Yeouido Investment Federation held a single drawing at the Yeouido hall to allocate the remaining band of Seoul's internal communications network to the hall's joint reception desk. The Sluice Bureau's Yeongdeungpo duty desk adjusted pump operating hours to match the time of the drawing. The Government of the Republic of Korea's Gwanghwamun duty desk wrote the hash of the delivery list in the witness ledger. The Jeongdong Labor Federation's City Hall duty desk checked the return line of the remittance records. Taeuk Group's Yangjae duty desk isolated false-positive records from the surface relay terminal. The Myeongdong Archdiocese updated its multilingual counseling queue tickets. The drawing determined the joint use of communication duty hours and the band, and granted neither ownership of land or facilities nor communication rights outside Seoul.
In June 2123, On Minui demanded that the Sluice Bureau submit a written re-submission to the emergency orders. The Sluice Bureau did not sign the consent form. The Transshipment Bureau, Sinnae Transport, the Standards League, and the White Cross Order withheld entry of succession and treaties in the Records Office. The Eastern Office and the Agwan Office continued to register succession and treaties with the Records Office. Yun Seorin withdrew the written demand for re-submission.
2123년 수문국, 규격맹, 환적국이 서로 다른 급수·부품·통행 계약을: In 2123, the Sluice Bureau, the Standards League, and the Transshipment Bureau sent differing water supply, parts, and passage contracts to the weak states in the same week. Jeong Yura transcribed only the termination conditions of the three contracts into one document. The document Jeong Yura copied out became the basic document of the Weak States Council.
2125년 11월 기록청은 세 국가 안에 존속한 십육국의 전신국·봉신 각: In November 2125, the Records Office compiled a ledger of strength and weakness for each of the Sixteen Kingdoms' predecessor states and vassals that had persisted within the three states. The Great Powers column listed the Government of the Republic of Korea, the Sluice Bureau, the Standards League, the Transshipment Bureau, the Eastern Office, and Taeuk Group. The Weak States column listed the Yeouido Investment Federation, the White Cross Order, the Agwan Office, and Sinnae Transport. The Minor States column listed Myeongbu Church, the Myeongdong Archdiocese, the Anguk Monastic Assembly, Seongha Group, the Central Intelligence Agency, and the Jeongdong Labor Federation.
2125년 12월 수문국·규격맹·환적국·동방사·태욱그룹은 각국 병력과 봉: In December 2125, the Sluice Bureau, the Standards League, the Transshipment Bureau, the Eastern Office, and Taeuk Group submitted to the Records Office muster documents for each state's troops and vassal troops. The Government Complex Guard maintained rotating guard duty at Gwanghwamun, Jongno 3-ga, and Euljiro Ipgu Station.
2126년 오경재가 장로 인준을 거쳐 당회장에 취임하였다. 유언 3장을: In 2126, O Gyeongjae took office as church moderator after approval by the elders. He made the three-chapter will public in the general assembly meeting room and did not approve Han Jaemok's western expansion proposal. Instead, they agreed to jointly seal, together with the Sluice Bureau, the original box of the pump maintenance process.
제1분공방(이씨)·제2분공방·태욱중공업 제2사업장: First Branch Workshop (I Clan) · Second Branch Workshop · Taeuk Heavy Industries Second Plant
2102년 4월 규격맹은 서울 안의 공방 업무를 제1분공방과 제2분공방으: In April 2102, the Standards League incorporated the workshop duties within Seoul into the First Branch Workshop and the Second Branch Workshop. The I clan maintained its vassal relationship with the Standards League and handled the production and inventory duties of the First Branch Workshop in Oryu 2-dong. The branch workshops sent parts made to specification to Guro. This incorporation and division of duties was not a grant of ownership of land or facilities.
제1분공방은 2102년 규격맹에 편입되었다. 이씨 가문은 규격맹의 봉신으: The First Branch Workshop was incorporated into the Standards League in 2102. The I clan, as a vassal of the Standards League, handled production and inventory duties in Oryu 2-dong. The clan's work was an operation linking parts production and grain storage, and was not control or ownership of the depot or workshop site. I Ilseop was the heir of the I clan.
2120년 겨울 동방사는 펌프 부품 공급의 대가로 규격맹에 복구복무자 등: In the winter of 2120, the Eastern Office demanded that the Standards League register restoration-service workers in return for supplying pump parts. Gang Minseo of the Standards League entered the engineers who refused to register in the Standards League citizenship roll. In 2121, the Standards League council elected Gang Minseo as chair.
2123년 11월 이일섭은 제1분공방 대표로 구로의 규격맹 평의회에 처음: In November 2123, I Ilseop attended the Standards League council in Guro for the first time as representative of the First Branch Workshop. The council granted branch workshop representatives only the right to speak. I Ilseop proposed receiving part of the payment for First Branch Workshop parts in seed instead of vouchers. Chair Gang Minseo accepted the proposal to pay one fifth of the payment in seed.
2124년 태욱중공업 제1사업장과 규격맹 제2분공방 노동자들이 정동노총에: In 2124, workers of Taeuk Heavy Industries Plant 1 and the Standards League's Second Branch Workshop joined the Jeongdong Labor Federation.
In May 2095, Taeuk Group controlled Taeuk Heavy Industries and 11 subordinate workshops. Seongha Group controlled four computing buildings around Seongha Electronics.
2101년 3월 태욱그룹은 양재의 기존 공장 업무에서 부품 제작과 수리를: In March 2101, Taeuk Group named the two work teams that had split parts production and repair within the existing Yangjae factory operations Taeuk Heavy Industries Plant 1 and Plant 2. The parts and workers of the two plants were assigned according to the production and repair rotation of the same Yangjae work space. Even in the first year, the workers of Plant 1 split production and repair between them. The organization of the work teams was not a grant of a new factory site or of land ownership.
2112년 4월 9일 태욱그룹 회장 정일환이 양재 본사 숙소에서 사망하였: On April 9, 2112, Taeuk Group Chairman Jeong Ilhwan died at his quarters in the Yangjae headquarters. Jeong Ilhwan's only child was a daughter, Jeong Seoon.
2112년 4월 15일 정서온은 부친이 남긴 지분 문서와 주주총회 의사록: On April 15, 2112, Jeong Seoon proclaimed her accession as chairman on the basis of the share document her father had left and two sets of shareholders' meeting minutes. The playgrounds of Gyeongseong Middle and High School and Hongik Design High School are daytime ration yards, and in front of Building 106 of Yeonnam Kolon Haneulchae, people close their windows when brazier smoke drifts in. After the central food contract ended, the price of oil in the market alley rose first.
성산1동 주민들은 개막일 공급 공백에 대응해 성미산학교 마당의 물 인계와: Residents of Seongsan 1-dong will set the water handover in the Seongmisan School yard and the residential carrying shifts in response to the supply gap on opening day, while leaving the drinking safety of stream water as a separate item to be confirmed.
상계8동은 상계주공11단지와 10단지 옥상 물통이 같은 난로를 놓고 다툰: Sanggye 8-dong's rooftop water tanks at Sanggye Jugong Complexes 11 and 10 fight over the same stove. Entry to Sanggye Jugong Complex 15 and foot traffic of Sanggye Complexes 14–16 share the handcarts. The playgrounds of Nowon High School, Sanggyeong Middle School, Seoul Sanggyeong Elementary, and Seoul Dongil Elementary are drying racks. Jungnangcheon is surveyed for its position only.
상계9동 주민센터는 대합실 단열과 14단지 배급을 같은 시각에 열지 말라: The Sanggye 9-dong Community Center left only a memo: do not open the waiting-hall insulation and the Complex 14 ration at the same time.
상계9동은 마들 승강장 대합실과 상계주공14단지 배급줄이 같은 난방을 나: In Sanggye 9-dong, the Madeul platform concourse and the ration line of Sanggye Jugong Complex 14 share the same heating. Household heads of Sanggye Jugong Complex 12 and Sanggye Complexes 11–13 watch the same turn order, and the playgrounds of Sangwon Elementary, Ongok Elementary, and Sangwon Middle School are waiting seats. Jiseonggwan is a candidate site for a one-night scribe stay.
상계10동 주민센터는 사업소 철재를 연공회의 인준 전 출고하지 말라는 메: The Sanggye 10-dong Community Center posted side by side a memo not to release the depot's steel before the Yeongong Council's ratification and a memo not to empty the Complex 7 stove. The terms of a new contract are under negotiation.
상계10동은 창동차량사업소 부지가 갈색 공터로 남아 철재를 거두는 자리고: In Sanggye 10-dong, the Changdong Rolling Stock Depot site remains a brown vacant lot where steel is collected, and household heads of Sanggye Jugong Complex 7 ask for that steel as stove and water-tank supports. The playgrounds of Yonghwa Girls' High School, Sangwol Elementary, Sanggok Elementary, and Ongok Middle School are drying racks, and the Gangbuk Road Traffic Education Center is a handcart practice yard. It lies within Samsung Group's sphere of influence, but that is not a declaration of ownership of the entire base.
개막일 은평구청과 녹번동 주민센터의 창작 접수조는 생활 배급과 통행 안내: On opening day, the custom intake teams of Eunpyeong District Office and Nokbeon-dong Community Center try to divide responsibility for daily rations and passage guidance.
녹번 대합실은 구청과 녹번동 주민센터 사이를 오가는 서명 줄을 세우고,: Nokbeon concourse lines up a signature queue running between the district office and Nokbeon-dong Community Center, and the scales at Daejo and Bulgwang markets put food boxes and medical kits on the same graduation marks. The Eunpyeong Teunteun Hospital lobby is where remaining kit counts are copied onto a chalkboard, and Jinheung-ro Small Forest is a shaded waiting area.
불광1동 주민 회의는 개막일 공급 공백 속에서도 독바위·불광 인계와 사면: The Bulgwang 1-dong residents' council tries to secure shifts that can sustain the Dokbawi–Bulgwang handover and slope inspections even amid the opening-day supply gap.
개막일 독바위 승강장 위 비탈은 낮에만 낙석줄을 치고, 불광 대합실은 그: On opening day, the slope above Dokbawi platform has rockfall ropes strung only in daytime, and Bulgwang concourse records only those who have passed through that rope. The rocky path between Suhyangbong and Seonlimbong is trodden first by scouts, and the pool below Bulgwang Falls is used only as hand-washing water, not as drinking water. The playgrounds of Seoul Bulgwang Elementary and Suri Elementary are rockfall shelter yards, and Bulgwang 1-dong Community Center posts only its daytime opening hours.
연서시장 상인과 박석고개 안내조는 실제 확인된 통과 시간에 맞춰 곡물 인: Yeonseo Market merchants and the Bakseok Pass guidance team negotiate grain handover according to actually confirmed transit times.
개막일 박석고개는 수레 바퀴가 미끄러운 낮문이고, 연서시장 좌판은 그 문: On opening day, Bakseok Pass is a daytime gate with slippery cart wheels, and Yeonseo Market stalls lay out only grain that has passed through that gate. Bulgwang 2-dong Community Center writes the pass's opening times on a chalkboard, and the playgrounds of Yeonsin Middle School, Yeoncheon Middle School, Yeonsin Elementary, and Bulgwang Middle School share stall covers and shelter space. The tree shade of Bulgwang Neighborhood Park is the yard for tying up loads.
개막일 연신내와 갈현1동 접수조는 기존 거주 가족의 연락·재결합 확인을: On opening day, the Yeonsinnae and Galhyeon 1-dong intake teams try to manage confirmation of contact and reunion for existing resident families separately from duty signatures.
개막일 연신내 대합실은 가족 재결합 명부와 숙영 순번을 한자리에 두되 복: On opening day, Yeonsinnae concourse keeps the family reunion roster and the camp-turn order in one place but writes them in separate columns from the duty roster. Galhyeon 1-dong Community Center accepts only the consent field filled in by the person themselves, and the rear gate of Cheonggu Seongsim Hospital waits for consent confirmation before injured names are put on the roster. The Galhyeon 1 District redevelopment vacant lot is a waiting spot, and the Tongil-ro roadside is a transit line, not a trunk road anyone owns. The roster's season is short, and cross-checking against the Changdong waiting line has not yet begun.
갈현2동 공동체는 계약 공백으로 연료 조달이 불안정해진 개막일에 학교 강: The Galhyeon 2-dong community negotiates the priorities for school-auditorium camping and stove inspections on opening day, when fuel supply became unstable due to the contract gap.
개막일 선일여자고등학교 강당은 넘친 숙영을 받는 난로 자리이고, 선정고·: On opening day, the Seonil Girls' High School auditorium is a stove spot that takes overflow campers, and the classrooms of Seonjeong High School, Daeseong High School, and Seonjeong Middle School fight over the same flue wood. The Seonil Girls' High School and Big Data High School stop is the entrance where shift labor is counted, and the yard of Hyeonjae Twinville Apartments is where stove ash is cooled. Yeonseo-ro does not accept the Galhyeon 1 roster line and admits only firewood carts. There is no night corridor in this alley.
개막일 구산역 주변 운반조와 창작 돌봄 담당자는 봉산 접근과 병원 건물: On opening day, the porter team around Gusan Station and the custom care staff try to assign shifts after confirming the actual status of Bongsan access and hospital building handover.
개막일 봉산 나무 그늘은 낮에만 약초 묶음을 내리고, 구산 승강장은 그: On opening day, the tree shade of Bongsan unloads herb bundles only in daytime, and Gusan platform is the entrance that passes those bundles to the scale at the Eunpyeong High School front gate. The railing of Seoul Rehabilitation Hospital is the handle that holds up campers with limited mobility, and the boundary toward Seobuk Hospital is a negotiated passage, not Gusan's possession. The Gusan Station–Yeil Girls' High School intersection keeps firewood and stretchers apart. Outer-city water purification is offline, and slope rockfall has still kept the night road closed.
대조동 주민센터와 단지 대표는 임시 저장통과 가구별 물 인계 순서를 함께: The Daejo-dong Community Center and the complex representatives jointly decide on temporary storage tanks and the order of per-household water handover.
개막일 힐스테이트메디알레 공사 골조는 물통을 거는 뼈대이고, 호반베르디움: On opening day, the construction frame of Hillstate Medial-le is the skeleton for hanging water tanks, and the yards of Hoban Verdium and Samsung Town divide that water among household jars. Daejo-dong Community Center records only the frame-tank turn order, and the National Institute of Health stop lines up the water-carrying shifts. The playgrounds of Dongmyeong Girls' High School and Daejo Elementary are shade for the tanks.
개막일 신진공고의 창작 수리반과 단지 주민은 중앙 부품 계약 공백에 대응: On opening day, the custom repair team of Sinjin Technical High School and complex residents try to divide shifts for tool repair and daily water hauling in response to the central parts contract gap.
개막일 신진자동차고등학교 실습동은 펌프 패킹과 수레 축을 고치는 공구 자: On opening day, the practice building of Sinjin Automobile High School is the tool station that repairs pump packing and cart axles, and the Bulgwangcheon riverbank is the bucket path that filters turbid water and lifts it to the complex jars. The yards of Hillstate Nokbeon Station and Nokbeon Station e-Pyeonhansesang Castle share that water, and Eungam 1-dong Community Center records only the pumping turns. The playgrounds of Yeongnak Middle School and Eunmyeong Elementary are where hoses are dried. Outer-city water purification is offline, and the Nokbeon concourse train does not stop in this alley.
응암시장 상인과 창작 의무조는 개막일 공급 협의가 흔들리자 공동 취사와: Eungam Market merchants and the custom medical team negotiate the stock and fuel allocation for communal cooking and medical meals as opening-day supply negotiations waver.
On opening day, the soup cauldron of Eungam Market fights over the same fire between ration soup and hospital gruel. The back door of Seoul Metropolitan Eunpyeong Hospital receives the gruel pots, and the corridor of Seoul Hyo Nursing Hospital is the line that gets gruel first. Eungam 2-dong Community Center posts the market scale and the hospital headcount on one chalkboard but keeps the columns separate. The Baengnyeonsan Hillstate entrance counts firewood carts, and Gajwa-ro allows only passage toward Seodaemun. A fake medicine box is not yet an officially recognized incident in this market.
대림시장골목의 상인과 주민 안내조는 야간 영업 조명과 천변 안전 점검에: The merchants of Daerim Market Alley and the residents' guidance team try to allocate supplies for night-trading lighting and streamside safety inspections.
개막일 대림시장골목은 등불 기름과 좌판 천이 같은 줄을 다툰다. 대림시장: On opening day, Daerim Market Alley's lamp oil and stall cloth fight over the same line. The inside of the Daerim Market building keeps dried herbs and salt jars, and Eungam 3-dong Community Center records only the alley lamp times. This stretch of Bulgwangcheon blocks the front of the stalls with sandbags, and the lower floors of Eungam Useong Apartments lift their belongings first when water comes in. The auditorium of Eunpyeong Culture Arts Information School is where wet cloth is dried.
개막일 서북병원 건물의 창작 의무조와 주민센터는 생활 물과 세척용 물을: On opening day, the custom medical team in the Seobuk Hospital building and the community center negotiate complex consumption and medical support while managing living water and washing water separately.
개막일 서울시립서북병원 마당은 거른 물을 병실 항아리에 올리는 자리이고,: On opening day, the yard of Seoul Metropolitan Seobuk Hospital is where filtered water is lifted into the ward jars, and Yeokchon concourse sets the stretcher turns that carry that water. Yeokchon-dong Community Center records hospital water supply and Centreville household supply on one chalkboard in separate columns. The foot of Bongsan brings down only fallen-leaf firewood, and the Yeokchon Elementary playground is the yard for washing stretchers.
개막일 기독대 강당의 창작 연락조는 가족 동의와 전언 전달을 복무 확인과: On opening day, the custom liaison team in the Christian University auditorium separates family consent and message delivery from duty verification and tries to notify residents of the Eungam handover times.
개막일 서울기독대학교 강당은 전언 종이와 가족 동의란을 같은 책상에 두되: On opening day, the auditorium of Seoul Christian University puts message slips and family consent fields on the same desk but writes them separately from the duty roster. The Eungam platform line passes toward Susaek only those who got the auditorium stamp, and Sinsa 1-dong Community Center posts the remaining stamp count. The Deoksan Middle School playground is where message carts stop, and the Dongu Villa terrace alley is the residence where lantern power goes out first. Sinsa Five-Way Intersection is a transit intersection, not a possession plaza.
신사2동 주민센터와 산새둥지 안내조는 개막일 계약 공백 속에서 은평터널: The Sinsa 2-dong Community Center and the Sansae Nest guidance team try to align the actual state of Eunpyeong Tunnel access with the Saejeol Station handover times amid the opening-day contract gap.
개막일 은평터널입구는 수레 높이를 재는 낮문이고, 새절 대합실은 그 문을: On opening day, the Eunpyeong Tunnel entrance is a daytime gate that measures cart height, and Saejeol concourse seats only those who passed through that gate in the waiting seats. Sinsa 2-dong Community Center and Sansae Nest post the tunnel opening times separately, and the playgrounds of Soongsil High School, Soongsil Middle School, and Sangsin Middle School are waiting-cover spots. This stretch of Bulgwangcheon is where carts coming out of the tunnel wash their wheels, and Jeungsan-ro 17-gil is the alley handed over toward Susaek. The night tunnel has not yet been opened.
개막일 디지털미디어시티·증산 인계조와 시장 상인은 중앙 공급 협의가 흔들: On opening day, the Digital Media City–Jeungsan handover team and market merchants try to separate the time slots for message and daily-life cargo as central supply negotiations waver.
개막일 디지털미디어시티 철도 대합실은 마포 송신 쪽으로 가벼운 전언과 상: On opening day, the Digital Media City railway concourse is the hole through which only light messages and boxes are passed toward the Mapo sending side, and Jeungsan platform is the entrance that moves those boxes to the market scale. Jeungsan Comprehensive Market fights over box weight and the ration soup cauldron, and the foot of Susaeksan is where box covers are dried. Wasangyo is a streamside passage, not a trunk road, and Susaek-ro is a negotiated road toward the rolling stock depot. Jichuk trains were not admitted, and only light cargo passes.
수색동 주민센터의 창작 인계조는 개막일 계약 공백에 대응해 서울차량사업소: The Susaek-dong Community Center's custom handover team negotiates the handover of supplies in the Seoul Rolling Stock Depot yard and residents' storage zones in response to the opening-day contract gap.
개막일 서울차량사업소 마당은 가벼운 상자만 바닥에 내려놓는 환적 자리이고: On opening day, the Seoul Rolling Stock Depot yard is a transshipment spot where only light boxes are set on the ground, and Susaek-dong Community Center records the yard's opening times. Susaekgyo is a bridge where boxes are passed over shoulders, and Susaek Station Intersection is a crossroads where carts stop, not a platform. The DMC Pine City Xi and Art Forêt Xi complexes fight over the box covers coming out of the yard against household stove firewood. The Seoul Susaek Elementary playground is the scale spot for weighing boxes. Jichuk trains were not admitted into this yard.
개막일 구파발 인계조와 진관동 안내자는 산지에서 확인한 보행 상태를 바탕: On opening day, the Gupabal handover team and the Jingwan-dong guide try to divide camp and medical handover times based on walking conditions confirmed in the mountains.
개막일 구파발 대합실은 북한산 서북 비탈에서 내려온 사람을 낮에만 받아: On opening day, Gupabal concourse is a gate that records, only in daytime, the people coming down from the northwestern slope of Bukhansan. Only when the Gijabong scouts report the rockfall on Gureumjeongwon-gil does Jingwan-dong Community Center open the corridor hours. The playgrounds of Jingwan High School, Jingwan Middle School, Jingwan Elementary, and Hana High School share camp spots and herb drying, and the entrance of Eunpyeong St. Mary's Hospital is the gate that holds injured people waiting before they are put on the corridor roster.
독립문 대합실은 낮 왕래만 연다. 소유 선언은 없고, 서울역 기록 쪽지와: Dongnimmun concourse opens only for daytime traffic. There is no ownership declaration, and it is negotiating whether to write Seoul Station record slips and market prices on the same chalkboard.
영천시장은 아침 두 시간만 저울을 열고, 세란병원 로비는 부상 순번을 시: Yeongcheon Market opens its scale for only two morning hours, and the Seran Hospital lobby says not to line up the injury turn with the market ration in a single line. The low floors near the Geukdong Apartments entrance try not to mix the market's evening line with the Dongnimmun traffic line.
주민센터는 숙영 명부만 연다. 두 아파트는 나무를 나누지 못한 채 협의: The community center opens only the camp roster. The two apartment complexes, unable to divide the wood, are negotiating. There is no ownership declaration.
아현삼거리와 마포대로가 맞닿는 골목에서 저층 잠자리를 판다. 북아현동두산: Low-floor beds are sold in the alley where Ahyeon Three-Way Intersection meets Mapo-daero. Bukahyeon-dong Doosan Apartments and Sinchon Prugio Apartments fight over the same heating wood. The line in front of the Wedding Town stop tries not to mix the Chunghyeon-side record-traffic beds with the Gongdeok-side food line.
충정로는 서울역 기록 왕래만 받는 남쪽 창구로 열린다. 서대문 대합실은: Chungjeong-ro opens as a south window accepting only Seoul Station record traffic. Seodaemun concourse lets through only daytime people.
충정로와 서대문 대합실이 나란히 문을 연다. 서소문아파트는 저녁 물통을: Chungjeong-ro and Seodaemun concourses open side by side. Seosomun Apartments asks which concourse's turn its evening water tanks should be matched to. The practice rooms of Chugye University for the Arts are used as beds for transit personnel, but the performance power is cut.
기울어진 옥인연립 물통 두 개의 보수와 오전 청운초 배급·낮 영추문 통행: Repairs to the two tilted water tanks at Okin Yeonrip, the morning ration at Cheongun Elementary School, and daytime passage at Yeongchumun must be coordinated within the same shift.
청운효자동 주민센터는 경사 지대 가구의 급수 순번을 다시 정한다. 옥인연: Cheongunhyoja-dong Community Center resets the water-supply order for households on the slope. At Okin Yeonrip, the tilted rooftop tank leaks into the kitchens below, and the daytime ration line from the Gyeongbok High School, Cheongun Middle School and Cheongun Elementary School playgrounds stretches down to Palpan-dong Samgeori. In front of Yeongchumun, only pedestrian passage is controlled.
개막일 광화문 창구는 새 급수·부품 문안을 접수하되 증인이 두 명 미만이: On opening day, the Gwanghwamun counter accepts new water-supply and parts documents but rejects them if there are fewer than two witnesses. The dehumidifier in the Gyeonghuigung air-raid shelter runs only intermittently.
광화문역 대합실과 사직동 주민센터는 서울역기록청의 인준·공증 업무를 나눠: The Gwanghwamun Station concourse and Sajik-dong Community Center share the endorsement and notarization work of the Seoul Station Records Office. A line of people waiting for transit passes forms toward Gyeongbokgung Station, the Gyeonghuigung air-raid shelter serves as an underground archive running dehumidifiers, and the Maedong Elementary School playground is used as a witness waiting area.
On opening day, only a sealing cord hangs at Mansedongbang Spring and there are too few watchers. The water tank in the Samcheong-dong Community Center yard is less than half full, and a note at the Bugak hiking trail says it is open only for the daytime stretch. At the hospital building entrance, document applicants and transferred patients are mixed in a single line.
만세동방 약수터에는 부적합 팻말이 남아 있지만 새벽부터 물통을 든 사람들: An unfit sign remains at Mansedongbang Spring, but from dawn people carrying buckets line up. Samcheong-dong Community Center posts water-supply order numbers while advising people not to mix spring water into the residents' shared tank. Rockfall watchers go up toward the Bugaksan trail and Cheongundae only in the daytime, and a transfer ledger hangs under the entrance eaves of the Armed Forces Seoul District Hospital building. The road in front of the Board of Audit and Inspection allows pedestrians only.
개막일 자하문로는 해가 떠 있는 동안만 열고 기차바위 감시는 두 교대만: On opening day, Jahamun-ro is open only while the sun is up, and the Gichabawi watch is staffed with just two shifts. Only pedestrians heading toward Seodaemun and resident households may use the daytime corridor. The fuel for the Wolhaegwan stove is one day's worth.
자하문로는 서대문 방향에서 부암 골목으로 들어오는 낮 회랑이다. 기차바위: Jahamun-ro is the daytime corridor entering the Buam alleys from the Seodaemun direction. Stones often fall below Gichabawi, so Buam-dong Community Center posts passage times on the wall. At night, households on the slope shelter inside Wolhaegwan at Sangmyung University, and at the Segeomjeong Elementary School playground people set down their water-carrying frames. The path toward Seokpajeong is closed because there is no guide.
개막일 사모바위 회랑에는 낮 구간만 안내 쪽지가 붙어 있다. 로이병원 건: On opening day, the Samobawi corridor has guidance notes posted for the daytime stretch only. Only bandages for ridge emergencies hang under the eaves of the Roi Hospital building.
평창동은 사모바위·숫사자봉·구진봉이 한눈에 보이는 능선 마을이다. 평창동: Pyeongchang-dong is a ridge village from which Samobawi, Sutsajabong and Gujinbong are all visible at a glance. Pyeongchang-dong Community Center issues daytime-corridor guide numbers, and on Bibong 1-gil people prepare for rockfall and wild boar movement. 2040년 오류2동의 경작자와 물자 운반자들은 식량을 한꺼번에 내보낸 뒤: In 2040, the farmers and goods carriers of Oryu 2-dong see neighbors who sent out all their food at once and could not last until the next sowing. They decide not to load onto the carts the grain they are keeping as seed, even when Guro merchants name a high price. Trade reopens, but the farmers decide how much goes out. This decision grants no land ownership and no authority to dispose of other residents' grain. From 2040, the AIs split apart into factions, and command and control weakened. When the slaughter stopped, people began to return to the surface. The activity of the killing machines and the fallout of the contamination humanity had left earlier drove the world into a permanent winter, and food shortages continued. As the first generation ended and the second began, temperatures rose slightly. Machines that had lost their purpose left the killing network and roamed in small packs, and people became able to deal with them. Between 2030 and 2040, Seoul's population fell sharply. Many shelters lost most of their residents and could not maintain their previous ration rolls. Some of the survivors tried to find other places to live within Seoul. Most programming knowledge and human technology survived, passed down orally among a small number of people. Once the internet vanished, knowledge became concentrated in them. Only those who knew how to handle electricity and technical equipment could run it, and some factions monopolized the technology. After the dark age, those who held technology grew into an engineer class. They built power on the knowledge of operating equipment and founded sixteen great powers in the second generation. In the second generation, humanoids could be connected to local networks and used again.

In May 2041, eleven monks from Jogyesa and the surrounding temples began copying the equipment manuals and sutras that had come from the Yeouido vault level and the water purification center. The English originals of the manuals were transcribed with Hangul pronunciations added. The copies were kept in the underground dharma hall at Anguk Station.

2041년 당산2동 한강변에서 배를 돌보던 선원과 주민들은 운항 중단이: In 2041, the boatmen and residents who had tended boats along the Han River in Dangsan 2-dong, as the suspension of sailing dragged on, jointly repair the boats they had used for work. The resident group that contributed people and materials to the repairs receives cargo space first on the next voyage within Seoul. Traffic to and from Yeouido opens whenever a boat can be mended, and word of work to be passed on to Yongsan also waits until the next carrier is found. The resident group uses the next cargo space on the boat it helped repair first, and carries on its riverside work.

Yun Sang-gwon was Yun Chang-bae's adopted son. The council of chiefs wrote Yun Sang-gwon's name at the end of the specifications and struck a line through Yun Chang-bae's name. Bae Jeong-man died in November 2042. His eldest son, Bae Hyeon-su, succeeded to the post of commander that same day in front of the guard. The guardsmen did not hold a separate election for a successor. Bae Hyeon-su recorded his father's name and date of death on the first page of the guard ledger.

The Register Church, the Anguk Grand Monastery, and the Myeongdong Archdiocese formed a religious alliance camp. The officers of the Administrative Duty Office sent the military service registers and stamp duty details received inside Seoul to the Gwanghwamun Records Office.
